papers.title: Error-Corrected Physics-Informed Neural Operator for Optimal Control of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles under Uncertainty
papers.summary: We solve open-loop optimal control problems under parametric uncertainty using a physics-informed DeepONet that returns trajectories for all sampled scenarios in one evaluation. Trained only on the residual at generic controls, the operator is reused across targets and horizons. Because a gradient-based optimizer exploits surrogate errors, we correct the prediction by one Newton step on the dynamics, computed for all scenarios and times by one parallel scan. The corrected state has a second-order error bounded by the residual alone, and the corrected cost is honest for every control up to the sampling error. On a fixed-wing UAV benchmark, the corrected operator matches the accuracy of a batched Adam solver and an Ipopt solver at equal sample size and is 8 times faster than the Adam solver on the same GPU at a few hundred scenarios and 15 times faster than Ipopt on a CPU.
papers.title_ja: 不確実性下での無人航空機最適制御のための誤差補正物理情報ニューラルオペレータ
papers.summary_ja: パラメータ不確実性を考慮した開ループ最適制御問題を、物理情報DeepONetを用いて高速に解く手法を提案する。汎用的な制御に対する残差のみで学習したオペレータを再利用し、勾配ベース最適化器がサロゲートの誤差を利用する問題を、ニュートン法による1ステップの誤差補正で解決する。この補正により、コスト関数はサンプリング誤差を除いてすべての制御に対して誠実（honest）になり、2次精度の誤差境界が保証される。固定翼UAVのベンチマークにおいて、既存のソルバと同程度の精度を維持しつつ、GPU上ではAdamソルバ比8倍、CPU上ではIpopt比15倍の高速化を実現した。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報ニューラルオペレータと最適制御の高速化という関心領域に完全に一致

papers.title: Energy-preserving Bayesian model reduction: closed-form structured posteriors and probabilistic stability certificates for quadratic operator inference
papers.summary: Bayesian operator inference learns reduced-order models (ROMs) with polynomial structure from state data and returns a closed-form Gaussian posterior over the reduced operators. That posterior is unconstrained, so it gives positive probability to operators with unbounded dynamics, and current practice controls this only through finite-horizon simulation tests on a few samples. We show that energy preservation of the quadratic operator is a set of linear equality constraints, which can be imposed exactly inside the Bayesian formulation without losing the closed form. In particular, the constrained posterior follows from one Kalman-type update of the unconstrained one, and its samples are obtained exactly, by the same correction applied to unconstrained draws. Under this structure, global boundedness for all initial conditions and bounded inputs reduces to a linear matrix condition on the symmetric part of the linear operator. The simulation test is then replaced by a probabilistic stability certificate: the posterior probability that the ROM is globally bounded, estimated with exact confidence bounds; the posterior restricted to certified models is then sampled exactly by rejection. For energy-conserving systems, the linear part can be constrained to be skew-symmetric as well: every draw then grows at most linearly in time, and conserves energy exactly when unforced. On a forced viscous Burgers' equation, the Korteweg-de Vries equation and a two-dimensional viscous Burgers' equation, every sample of the constrained posterior integrates to a bounded trajectory, where up to all unconstrained draws diverge, and beyond the observation window the former is also the more accurate of the two.
papers.title_ja: エネルギー保存型ベイズモデル縮約：二次オペレータ推論における閉形式の構造化事後分布と確率的安定性証明書
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、ベイズオペレータ推論においてエネルギー保存性を線形等式制約として厳密に課すことで、閉形式のガウス事後分布を維持しつつ安定性を保証する手法を提案する。従来の有限時間シミュレーションによる検証に代わり、線形行列条件に基づく確率的安定性証明書を用い、ROMが全体的に有界である確率を信頼区間付きで推定する。エネルギー保存系では線形部分を反対称に制約することで、任意の初期条件・入力に対して軌道の有界性を保証し、観測窓外でも精度を向上させる。強制粘性バーガー方程式やKdV方程式などの数値実験で、無制約モデルが発散するのに対し、本手法は全サンプルが有界な軌道を生成し、より正確な予測を行うことを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: ベイズ最適化とサロゲートモデル（ROM）の組み合わせであり、物理法則を組み込んだ安定性保証が関心に直結する。

papers.title: SDG: State-Dependent Gating at Chunk Boundaries for Linear Attention
papers.summary: Recent gated linear attention models use state-independent gates, computed from token representations without directly reading the recurrent memory. This design supports efficient chunkwise computation: sequences are divided into chunks of consecutive tokens, with parallel computation within each chunk. However, the same token representation produces the same gate, even when the layer stores different information. We introduce State-Dependent Gating (SDG), which computes element-wise gates from the change in memory over a chunk and applies them at the chunk boundary. This provides state feedback for forgetting while preserving parallel computation within each chunk. We develop fused kernels for Gated DeltaNet, Kimi Delta Attention, Gated DeltaNet-2, and Mamba-3. Our theoretical analysis quantifies the potential reconstruction benefits of state-dependent, element-wise gating under a signal--noise model. We also show that boundary decay is an element-wise ridge proximal step when the gate is held fixed. Empirical evaluation of 1.3B linear attention and hybrid models trained on 100B tokens shows improvements across language modeling, commonsense reasoning, synthetic and real-world retrieval, and long-context understanding. These results demonstrate that SDG is an effective approach to enhancing existing linear attention models.
papers.title_ja: 線形アテンションにおけるチャンク境界での状態依存型ゲーティング（SDG）
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、線形アテンションモデルの効率化と性能向上を目的とした新しいゲーティング手法「状態依存型ゲーティング（SDG）」を提案する。従来のトークン表現に基づくゲートとは異なり、チャンク内のメモリ変化に基づいて要素ごとにゲートを計算し、チャンク境界で適用することで、並列計算を維持しつつ効果的な忘却メカニズムを実現する。Gated DeltaNetやMamba-3などの既存アーキテクチャ向けに融合カーネルを開発し、理論的解析と1.3Bパラメータモデルでの実証実験を通じて、言語モデリングや長文脈理解における性能向上を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論高速化と効率化の核心技術であり、ユーザーの関心と高度に一致

papers.title: TDI-$\infty$ and beyond
papers.summary: Time-delay interferometry (TDI) cancels the laser frequency noise that dominates the measurements of the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA), and relies on interpolating the laser noise to fractional delays. In TDI-$\infty$, which finds the laser noise free combinations from a linear model of the measurements, the interpolation sets the design matrix, and any interpolation error leaves uncanceled laser noise which is not accounted for. We introduce Gaussian process (GP) interpolation into TDI-$\infty$, which models the laser noise from its spectrum and propagates its interpolation error into the likelihood as a covariance. We test it on a realistic data model in which the measurements pass through the on-board anti-alias filter and are downsampled to the 4 Hz telemetry rate, either applying the filter after the delays, as on the spacecraft, or building the filter into the GP kernel. We compare it with Lagrange and cosine-sum interpolation, and also keep the column space of the design matrix, which the standard null space likelihood discards. In lisainstrument simulations all three interpolators cancel the laser noise for a 1 Hz filter band edge, but only the GP does so up to the 2 Hz Nyquist frequency, a range the Lagrange and cosine-sum interpolators were not designed for. In parameter estimation on 200 simulated galactic binaries, the GP with the filter in its kernel gives the smallest calibrated posteriors. The differences are small for a single long data segment and grow when the data are split into short chunks or contain gaps, where the column space also recovers some information, by an amount that depends on the threshold that defines the null space.
papers.title_ja: TDI-∞ とその先へ
papers.summary_ja: LISA 衛星のレーザー周波数ノイズ除去手法 TDI-∞ に、ガウス過程（GP）補間を導入する。GP はノイズスペクトルから補間誤差をモデル化し、尤度関数の共分散として伝播させることで、従来の Lagrange やコサイン和補間では扱えなかった高周波数域（2 Hz ニュイキスト周波数まで）でのノイズ除去を実現する。さらに、設計行列の列空間を保持することで、データ分割やギャップがある場合の推定精度も向上させる。200 個の銀河系連星シミュレーションにおいて、GP 手法が最も正確な較正済み事後分布を与え、実務的なデータ処理の改善を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: ガウス過程という関心手法の応用であり、物理系での推定精度向上に直結する。

papers.title: Search-Informed MPPI for Kinodynamic Motion Planning via Monte Carlo Tree Expansion
papers.summary: Kinodynamic motion planning in large-scale, cluttered environments remains challenging, as dynamically feasible, collision-free trajectories must be computed efficiently over long horizons. Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) can strategically explore long-horizon alternatives but faces large branching factors in continuous control spaces and often relies on random default-policy rollouts, whereas Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) efficiently optimizes local trajectories yet remains susceptible to obstacle-induced local minima. To overcome these challenges, we propose Search-Informed MPPI (SI-MPPI), a unified framework that embeds MPPI trajectory optimization within MCTS-based tree search. The core concept is to fuse the expansion and default-policy simulation stages of MCTS into a single MPPI expansion stage guided by structured intermediate targets, termed baits. During each expansion, an adaptive bait-handling rule retains geometrically valid baits as local targets for GPU-batched MPPI optimizations that generate dynamically feasible candidate motion segments. Feasibility gating then checks these candidates for collision safety and sufficient progress, and top-$k$ selection admits the lowest-cost accepted candidates as tree edges, yielding sparse, directed tree growth; thereafter, effective sample size (ESS)-guided adaptation warm-starts subsequent expansions, while cost-based backpropagation updates tree statistics. Extensive simulations across four large-scale, cluttered 2D occupancy-grid maps demonstrate that SI-MPPI consistently produces the smallest search trees and smoothest angular control profiles compared with three kinodynamic baselines, while maintaining competitive planning times and path lengths. Ablation results further highlight the importance of GPU batching, adaptive bait handling, and retaining multiple expansion candidates for planning efficiency and robustness.
papers.title_ja: モンテカルロツリー拡張による運動学的運動計画のための検索情報活用型MPPI
papers.summary_ja: 大規模な障害物環境における運動学的運動計画の課題に対し、モンテカルロツリーサーチ（MCTS）とモデル予測パス積分（MPPI）を統合した新フレームワークSI-MPPIを提案する。MCTSの展開とデフォルトポリシーシミュレーションを、構造化された中間目標（ベイト）で導かれる単一のMPPI展開段階に融合し、GPUバッチ処理による効率的な軌道最適化を実現する。適応的なベイト処理と実行可能性ゲーティングにより、衝突安全かつ進捗のある候補のみをツリーに採用し、スパースで方向性のあるツリー成長を促す。4つの大規模2Dグリッドマップでのシミュレーションにより、既存ベースラインと比較して最小の検索ツリーサイズと最も滑らかな角速度制御プロファイルを示し、計画時間の競合性を維持することが確認された。
papers.relevance_reason: 軌道設計・最適化とML手法（MCTS/MPPI）の融合であり、ユーザーの関心領域に直結する。

papers.title: Joint Optimization of Fleet Size, Localization Infrastructure, and Trajectories for Multi-AUV Persistent Monitoring
papers.summary: Persistent monitoring of large-scale subsea infrastructure, such as offshore wind farm foundations, export cables, and inspection corridors, remains a fundamental challenge for autonomous underwater systems. The problem is not solely spatial coverage, but rather temporal coverage: ensuring that all relevant regions of interest are revisited within bounded time intervals under limited sensing, navigation uncertainty, and constrained vehicle resources. We compare three classes of trajectory strategies: (1) deterministic lane-based coverage (lawnmower patterns), (2) stochastic exploration (biased random walk with boundary constraints), and (3) coordinated partition-based strategies (Voronoi tessellation). Rather than seeking a universally superior method, we evaluate how varying levels of localization accuracy impact temporal coverage across two distinct operational profiles: persistent monitoring of the entire operational workspace versus targeted inspection of critical infrastructure. We present a simulation-based, quantitatively grounded study of temporal coverage in multi-AUV persistent monitoring, disentangling three interacting design dimensions: (i) trajectory generation strategy, (ii) fleet size, and (iii) localization accuracy provided by fixed acoustic beacon infrastructure. We introduce a cost-aware evaluation framework combining fleet size, number of beacons, and mission energy expenditure into a unified cost function. Results demonstrate that beyond a certain accuracy threshold, improvements in localization yield diminishing returns compared to coordinated trajectory design, an effect often obscured in integrated navigation-planning approaches. Coordinated-partition trajectories enable a reduced fleet size to achieve superior temporal coverage at a 39-46% lower overall life-cycle cost than rigid deterministic paths unoptimized for the localization infrastructure.
papers.title_ja: 多AUV持続監視における艦隊規模、位置特定インフラ、軌道の共同最適化
papers.summary_ja: 自律水中ロボット（AUV）による大規模海底インフラの持続監視において、軌道戦略・艦隊規模・位置特定精度の3要素を統合的に最適化する手法を提案する。決定論的カバレッジ、確率的探索、Voronoi分割に基づく協調戦略を比較し、位置特定精度が時間的カバレッジに与える影響を定量的に評価した。コスト関数を用いた評価により、一定の精度閾値を超えると位置特定改善の効果が頭打ちになる一方、協調軌道設計が艦隊規模の削減とライフサイクルコストの大幅低減（39-46%）に有効であることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 軌道最適化とコスト評価の統合が関心に合致

papers.title: Learning Adaptive Defense Strategies: Fine-Tuned LLMs for Network Security Games under Network Mobility
papers.summary: Large language models(LLM) show promise for strategic reasoning, yet their ability to compute game-theoretic equilibria under dynamic conditions remains largely unexplored. This work investigates whether fine-tuned LLMs can serve as solver-free surrogates for online equilibrium computation in honeypot allocation, a setting in which network mobility continuously reshapes the underlying attack graph and forces repeated re-solving of a two-player zero-sum game. We construct a dataset of 270 security games on networks of 8--25 nodes with solver-grounded equilibrium labels, and evaluate four classes of predictor over 1{,}524 held-out mobility events: non-learned baselines, six open-weight architectures evaluated zero-shot, the same six after LoRA fine-tuning, and four proprietary models as an external reference point. Predictions are scored without post-hoc repair against exact game-theoretic criteria: exploitability against an optimal attacker best-response, equilibrium support accuracy, and distributional distance. Fine-tuning reduces exploitability across every architecture, and fine-tuned open-weight models of modest size outperform every zero-shot predictor, including proprietary ones; no zero-shot model at any tier reaches the floor set by uniform allocation. Stratifying by mobility type exposes a qualitative shift that aggregate metrics conceal: zero-shot models do not condition on whether a departing node lies on an attack path, while fine-tuned models recover this distinction. We further find that validation loss is negatively rank-correlated with task performance, and that output validity, rather than predictive accuracy, is the binding constraint on further progress.
papers.title_ja: 適応的防御戦略の学習：ネットワークモビリティ下でのネットワークセキュリティゲームにおけるファインチューニング済みLLM
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、動的なネットワーク環境下でのゲーム理論的均衡計算において、ファインチューニング済みLLMがソルバー不要なサロゲートモデルとして機能するかを調査する。ハニーポット配置問題における270件のセキュリティゲームデータセットを用い、LoRAファインチューニングにより、ゼロショット推論モデルやプロプライエタリモデルを上回る性能を示した。特に、ノードの離脱が攻撃パスに関わるかという文脈条件付けをファインチューニングモデルが正しく学習していることを示し、検証損失とタスク性能の相関や出力妥当性の重要性を指摘している。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの効率化とサロゲートモデル、ゲーム理論的推論の組み合わせが関心に合致

papers.title: A Validation-Driven Bilevel Optimization Method for Mesh-Free PDE Solvers and Its Error Analysis
papers.summary: Mesh-free partial differential equation (PDE) solvers construct discrete systems from residuals at sampled points. These solvers fit coefficients in a parameterized trial representation and select solver-design parameters governing the representation, training-residual weighting, and regularization. These parameters strongly affect solution accuracy, yet existing selection strategies are largely tailored to particular solver classes. To address this limitation, we formulate a unified validation-driven bilevel optimization framework applicable across different solver classes, in which the lower level fits coefficients using training collocation residuals, while the upper level selects solver-design parameters using held-out validation residuals. For nonlinear PDEs, however, solving the nonlinear lower-level problem to high accuracy is costly, while the adjoint system is typically ill-conditioned and indefinite. To address this issue, we propose an efficient implicit hypergradient method that approximates the lower-level response using finite, warm-started damped Gauss-Newton (GN) updates. For the adjoint solve, we use the damped GN matrix to compute an initial adjoint and to precondition a finite number of minimum residual iterations. To quantify the errors introduced by these approximations, we derive local hypergradient error bounds that separate the contributions of the finite lower-level solve, adjoint damping, and the final adjoint residual. Combining this analysis with validation sampling bounds and residual stability, we relate validation residuals to PDE solution accuracy and establish error bounds for the computed PDE solution. Numerical experiments on several nonlinear PDEs, including a high-dimensional problem, demonstrate the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed method across Kansa, random feature and extreme learning machine, and physics-informed neural network solvers.
papers.title_ja: メッシュフリーPDEソルバのための検証駆動型二層最適化手法とその誤差解析
papers.summary_ja: メッシュフリーPDEソルバの設計パラメータ選択を、検証データを用いた二層最適化問題として統一する枠組みを提案する。非線形PDEにおける計算コストと連立方程式の不安定性に対し、減衰ガウス・ニュートン法を用いた効率的なハイパーグラデント近似手法を導出する。さらに、近似誤差の局所境界を導き、検証残差とPDE解の精度との関係を理論的に確立する。Kansa法やPINNなど複数のソルバでの数値実験により、高精度かつ効率的な解法であることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報ニューラルネットとPDE解法の最適化・誤差解析が関心に直結

papers.title: A 3D PINN-Based Framework for Patient-Specific Pulmonary Hemodynamics Using Windkessel Models
papers.summary: Cardiovascular fluid dynamics modeling relies heavily on mesh-based numerical methods such as Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD). While accurate, these methods entail significant computational costs and complex meshing workflows that limit their translation to clinical practice. Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) are a promising meshless alternative that embeds the governing equations directly into neural network training. In this work, we propose a PINN framework for pulsatile blood flow in patient-specific geometries with dynamic lumped-parameter Windkessel (RCR) outlet conditions representing distal vascular impedance. Coupling the Windkessel ODE to a 3D network raises two difficulties: the ODE alone does not fix the pressure level, and the local pressure variations that drive the flow are orders of magnitude smaller than the basal pressure imposed by the outlet. We address them by decomposing pressure into a time-dependent basal part and a spatially varying part, an initial condition and gauge for the Windkessel equation, a global mass-balance constraint, and a periodic Fourier embedding of time. Validated on 2D canonical channels (steady and pulsatile, with and without RCR outlet), the framework is then applied to a patient-specific right pulmonary artery, reproducing outlet flow, mean pressure, and the velocity and dynamic pressure fields with errors on the order of the data resolution. Finally, we solve the inverse problem of identifying the three Windkessel parameters of the outlet from synthetic data, recovering them with errors of about 0.3% from deliberately wrong initial values. Residual biases in the local pressure field and the need to test robustness to noisy clinical data remain open, but the results support PINNs as complementary tools for meshless hemodynamics and patient-specific digital twins.
papers.title_ja: Windkesselモデルを用いた患者固有の肺血流力学のための3次元PINNベースフレームワーク
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、メッシュ不要な物理情報ニューラルネットワーク（PINN）を用いて、患者固有の肺動脈における脈動血流をシミュレートするフレームワークを提案する。遠位血管インピーダンスを表すWindkesselモデル（RCR）を境界条件として結合し、圧力分解や質量保存則の制約により数値安定性を確保した。2次元標準チャネルでの検証後、患者固有の3次元肺動脈モデルに適用し、出口流量や圧力場を高精度で再現した。さらに、合成データからWindkesselパラメータを逆問題として同定し、初期値が誤っていても約0.3%の誤差で復元できることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: PINNと物理モデル結合、逆問題解決という関心領域と高度に一致

papers.title: A sliding mode observer perspective on chaos synchronisation of turbulent flows
papers.summary: State estimation of turbulent flows is challenging as infinitesimal prediction errors grow exponentially due to chaos. However, when signals from one chaotic system (the master) are injected into an identical system with different initial conditions (the slave), the slave can synchronise with the master --- a phenomenon observed in turbulent flows. From a control-theoretic perspective, this synchronisation problem can be viewed as observer design. We first show that synchronisation by direct substitution of observed variables into the slave system is equivalent to a sliding mode observer. This perspective enables the analytical verification of stability as well as the design of feedback for robustness. We focus on reduced-order Navier--Stokes models with quadratic non-linearities, a broad class of systems for which stability can be analysed by seeking Lyapunov functions through parameter-dependent linear matrix inequalities solved via semidefinite programming. Extending this framework, we develop a neural network approach combining a neural ordinary differential equation with a decoder to learn data-driven mappings from observation histories to companion forms, where observer design is greatly simplified. Results are demonstrated on the Lorenz system and a nine-dimensional reduced order model of a turbulent shear flow. This work opens opportunities in the rigorous development of observers for turbulent flows.
papers.title_ja: 乱流のカオス同期におけるスライディングモードオブザーバーの視点
papers.summary_ja: 乱流の状態推定において、カオス同期を制御理論のオブザーバー設計として定式化する手法を提案する。直接置換による同期がスライディングモードオブザーバーに等価であることを示し、Lyapunov関数を用いた安定性の解析的検証と頑健性フィードバック設計を可能にする。さらに、ニューラルODEとデコーダーを組み合わせたデータ駆動型マッピング学習により、観測履歴から伴従形式への変換を学習し、オブザーバー設計を簡素化する。Lorenz系と乱流せん断流の縮約モデルで有効性を検証し、厳密なオブザーバー開発への道を開く。
papers.relevance_reason: 縮約モデルとニューラルODEによる物理系推定が関心に合致

papers.title: Do DeepONet Trunk-Basis Preconditioners Need Training?
papers.summary: Trunk-basis (TB) preconditioners build the coarse space of a two-level Schwarz preconditioner from the trunk functions of a trained deep operator network (DeepONet), restricted to subdomains. Their effectiveness has been attributed to spectral bias since networks learn low frequencies first, complementing a smoother that removes the high-frequency error. Spectral bias, however, is a property of training, whereas a randomly initialized trunk with a smooth activation is already smooth. We therefore ask whether TB preconditioners need training. In one dimension, we prove that on each subdomain the span of untrained trunk functions is close to the space of low-degree polynomials under suitable nondegeneracy assumptions. Numerically, for the Poisson equation and three-dimensional linear elasticity with constant coefficients, untrained TB and piecewise polynomial coarse spaces of equal dimension yield close conjugate gradient iteration counts, while training with the standard \(\ell^2\) loss sometimes increases them. Training can improve iteration counts when high-contrast coefficients make the low-energy modes non-smooth, and if the loss measures the error in the energy norm. For the Poisson equation with contrast \(10^5\), energy-trained TB coarse spaces need fewer iterations than piecewise polynomials of equal dimension, whereas \(\ell^2\)-trained ones do not. For a topology-optimized elastic cantilever with contrast \(10^6\), the energy-trained TB space enriched with the rigid-body modes gives the fewest iterations at larger coarse dimensions. This suggests that for neural operator-based hybrid solvers, a network's inductive bias and training objective should match the solver.
papers.title_ja: DeepONet トランクベース前処理子は学習を必要とするのか？
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、深層オペレータネットワーク（DeepONet）のトランク関数を用いた2段階シュワルツ前処理子の性能を分析する。1次元では、学習前のトランク関数のスパンが低次数多項式空間に近づくことを理論的に証明した。数値実験では、定数係数のポアソン方程式や線形弾性問題において、学習前の前処理子と同等次元の多項式ベースの前処理子は類似の反復回数を示す一方、標準的なℓ2損失による学習はむしろ反復回数を増加させる場合があることが判明した。高コントラスト係数を持つ問題では、エネルギーノルムに基づく損失関数を用いた学習が有効であり、ネットワークの帰納バイアスと学習目標がソルバーの特性と一致することが重要であることが示唆された。
papers.relevance_reason: ニューラルオペレータと物理情報手法の組み合わせであり、数値計算の高速化に直結する。

papers.title: Depth-Linked Residual Tokens for Multimodal Retrieval and Generation
papers.summary: Iterative architectures such as looped language models improve parameter efficiency and reasoning capacity of transformers, yet their sequential backbone iterations introduce substantial computational latency. Conversely, parallelizable learnable special tokens (such as the register tokens in Vision Transformer) enable efficient single-pass inference, but often suffer from the absence of sequential refinement and exhibit redundant representations across tokens. To address these challenges, we introduce Depth-Linked Residual Tokens (DepThink), an efficient framework designed for multimodal retrieval and generation. Operating within a single pre-filling forward pass, DepThink appends a sequence of K learnable residual tokens whose hidden states are coupled through a lightweight, learnable residual recurrence. This mechanism enables each residual token to progressively capture complementary information missed by preceding tokens. Theoretically, we prove that DepThink provides strictly expanded geometric directional reachability over standard learnable tokens and guarantees a provable one-step descent advantage. We evaluate DepThink across multimodal retrieval and generation tasks. DepThink consistently outperforms learnable-token baselines and matches or exceeds looped architectures across dense (2B, 8B) and sparse mixture-of-experts (30B-A3B) backbones under both LoRA and full-parameter fine-tuning, while accelerating training by up to 11.9 and inference by 4.3 over looped architectures.
papers.title_ja: マルチモーダル検索と生成のための深さ連動残差トークン
papers.summary_ja: 反復型アーキテクチャの計算遅延と、並列可能な学習可能トークンの表現冗長性という課題を解決するため、DepThinkというフレームワークを提案する。単一のフォワードパス内で、軽量な残差再帰によって隠れ状態が結合された学習可能残差トークンを追加し、逐次的な情報補完を実現する。理論的に、標準的な学習可能トークンに対する幾何学的到達可能性の拡張と、1ステップ降下優位性を証明している。マルチモーダル検索・生成タスクにおいて、ループ型アーキテクチャと同等以上の性能を維持しつつ、推論速度を最大4.3倍高速化することを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論高速化と効率化の手法であり、ユーザーの関心と強く一致する

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning Unlearns Corrupted SFT Reasoning
papers.summary: We show that reinforcement learning (RL) in reasoning tasks can succeed even when the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data is severely corrupted. In a mathematical reasoning dataset (GSM8K), we systematically corrupt training trajectories across 361 configurations by injecting realistic error types, varying error locations, trace-answer consistency, and corruption ratios up to 100%. While aggregated SFT-only performance steadily deteriorates under corruption (dropping from 43.61% to 13.80%), Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) post-training consistently restores model accuracy back to gold-baseline levels (approximately 60%). Crucially, initializing RL with as few as N = 8 minimal, incorrect, three-line "form-only" traces boosts post-RL performance to 69.30%, outperforming standard gold SFT initialization (60.71%) and GRPO without SFT (35.00%). Further, we show that SFT accuracy is largely uncorrelated with post-RL accuracy (r approximately 0), demonstrating a fundamental asymmetry in post-training: SFT primarily establishes structural layout (form), while RL independently discovers functional reasoning (function).
papers.title_ja: 強化学習は破損したSFT推論を学習し直す
papers.summary_ja: 本研究は、推論タスクにおいて強化学習（RL）が、監督ファインチューニング（SFT）データが深刻に破損している場合でも成功し得ることを示す。GSM8Kデータセットで361通りの破損設定をテストした結果、SFT単独の性能は低下する一方、GRPOによる後続学習はモデル精度をゴールドベースライン（約60%）まで回復させた。さらに、わずか8件の誤った「形式のみ」のトレースでRLを初期化すると、標準的なゴールドSFT初期化（60.71%）やSFTなしのGRPO（35.00%）を上回る69.30%の性能を達成した。SFTの精度とRL後の精度には相関がほぼなく、SFTが構造（形式）を確立し、RLが機能（推論）を独立して発見するという非対称性が明らかになった。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論の効率化と強化学習手法の組み合わせに直結

papers.title: Don't Discard Your Rollouts: Reusing Teacher RL Traces for Student Distillation
papers.summary: RL post-training methods such as PPO and GRPO are computationally expensive, with substantial resources devoted to sampling rollouts, which contain multiple completions per prompt along with their respective rewards. Canonical distillation, however, discards these traces and uses more compute to regenerate data from the final teacher. We ask if and how we can reuse the saved teacher RL rollouts to distil student models. Reusing rollouts is non-trivial: naive SFT on the rollouts underperforms canonical distillation, and naive DPO, while performant, is unstable, collapsing on weaker students. We show that treating rollout reuse as a data selection problem using metadata already recorded during GRPO substantially reduces this gap. We use prompt pass rates to order the data, using the easiest prompts for an SFT warm start prior to using mixed-success prompts for DPO. For each prompt, we use saved teacher log-likelihoods as a proxy for selecting student-compatible completions. Across mathematical reasoning and Python coding tasks, with students from multiple model families, our two-stage recipe achieves comparable average performance to canonical distillation, while incurring no additional inference cost for dataset construction.
papers.title_ja: ロールアウトを破棄するな：教師RLトレースの再利用による生徒蒸留
papers.summary_ja: PPOやGRPOなどの強化学習後学習で生成された教師モデルのロールアウト（推論過程と報酬）を、生徒モデルへの蒸留に再利用する手法を提案する。単純なSFTやDPOでは性能が劣るため、プロンプトのパス率と教師の対数尤度を用いたデータ選択戦略を導入した。この2段階アプローチにより、追加の推論コストなしで正規の蒸留と同等の性能を数学推論やコーディングタスクで達成した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの効率化・蒸留・RL手法の最適化に直結する

papers.title: Search From the Start: Search-Native Pretraining for Language Models
papers.summary: Modern language models (LMs) are increasingly deployed with access to search tools at inference. Yet pretraining remains predominantly focused on predicting static text, with search capabilities typically introduced during post-training. We propose Search-Native Pretraining as a practical route to teach search capability during pretraining from ordinary text corpora. Specifically, we augment pretraining corpus at scale with web-search queries and retrieve web response using a local index. Training on this augmented corpus teaches models to generate search calls and incorporate retrieved evidence during language modeling. Across Wikipedia and DCLM-Edu corpora and 360M to 3.3B parameter scales, search-pretrained models ("QueryLM") show improved performance on knowledge-intensive tasks and higher steerability toward the retrieved evidence. Crucially, their advantage persists after supervised fine-tuning of both search-pretrained and conventionally pretrained models, indicating that the tested post-training procedures do not fully recover the capabilities developed during pretraining. Throughout our experiments, we find that a 1.4B QueryLM consistently beats or matches the performance of a FLOP-matched 3.3B baseline model across all knowledge intensive tasks. These results establish search-pretraining as a practical way to develop foundational search capabilities during pretraining. We release the training artifacts, including model checkpoints and data.
papers.title_ja: 検索から始める：言語モデルのための検索ネイティブ事前学習
papers.summary_ja: 推論時の検索ツール利用を前提とする現代のLLMにおいて、事前学習段階から検索能力を内面化させる「Search-Native Pretraining」手法を提案する。通常のテキストコーパスにウェブ検索クエリとローカルインデックスによる検索結果を追加し、モデルが検索呼び出しを生成し証拠を組み込むことを学習させる。WikipediaやDCLM-Eduを用いた実験では、1.4BパラメータのモデルがFLOP同等の3.3Bモデルを上回る知識集約型タスク性能を示し、後続のファインチューニングでもその優位性が維持されることを確認した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの推論効率化とRAG設計の根本的改善に直結する手法

papers.title: Neural Geometry as a Learning Signal
papers.summary: We investigate whether the geometric structure of neural representations can provide a sufficient learning signal for improving model behavior without any supervision on model outputs. First, we fine-tune Llama-3.1-8B to answer questions such as "What month is four months after June?" by supervising internal representations of the input month (June = 6) and offset (4), which are encoded with Fourier harmonics. Second, we fine-tune the model to predict line breaks in text wrapped to a fixed width by supervising an internal representation of the number of characters since the preceding newline, which is represented by a low-dimensional helical structure. In both tasks, we supervise a low-dimensional subspace of the residual stream using an idealized target structure, and find that internal geometric supervision achieves similar performance to standard fine-tuning (despite no supervision on outputs). Moreover, we find that simply patching in an ideal geometry is not sufficient to recover fine-tuning performance, and thus demonstrate geometric supervision provides beneficial effects beyond the representations it targets. Together, these findings show how mechanistic understanding of neural geometry can be leveraged to shape the behavior of neural networks.
papers.title_ja: ニューラルジオメトリを学習シグナルとして利用する
papers.summary_ja: 本研究は、モデル出力の教師信号なしに、内部表現の幾何学的構造を監督することでLLMの性能を向上させられるかを調査した。Llama-3.1-8Bを用い、月日の計算や改行予測において、残差ストリームの低次元部分空間に理想的な幾何構造（フーリエ調波や螺旋構造）を課すことで、標準的なファインチューニングと同等の性能を達成した。また、単に幾何構造をパッチするだけでは不十分であり、幾何学的監督が対象外の表現にも有益な影響を与えることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの内部表現制御と効率化に関わる手法であり、ユーザーの関心に合致する。

papers.title: LLMs Memorize Their Own Hallucinations During Post-Training
papers.summary: Reasoning domains have shaped the post-training recipes of frontier models even though they are trained and deployed in domains beyond math and code. In this paper, we study the consequences of directly adopting reasoning-centric training recipes, e.g., the use of outcome-based rewards for reinforcement learning (RL), injection of "cognitive" behaviors such as proposing and backtracking from hypotheses in reasoning chains, etc., for knowledge tasks. We hypothesize that these decisions, while useful for reasoning, inadvertently encourage models to memorize hallucinations they themselves generate in their long reasoning chains when trained on knowledge tasks. To study this, we train models with standard post-training, extract their self-generated hallucinations during RL, and track memorization throughout the rest of training. Our experiments on six open models across two model families and two architectures confirm our hypothesis. We find that models' recall of hallucinations reinforced during training increases by 4.83% on average, compared to just 0.17% for self-hallucinations that receive no training signal. In fact, models even memorize false facts that they immediately retract in their reasoning; a backtracking template inherited from reasoning-centric training that has no benefit for knowledge recall. Furthermore, we find that memorization is strongest on the hardest training questions, and rewarding a hallucination makes the model less likely to abstain from it later (by 7.23% on average). Overall, our work identifies and systematically studies a previously unexamined pathway through which models learn hallucinations during training.
papers.title_ja: LLMは後学習中に自身のハルシネーションを記憶する
papers.summary_ja: 推論特化型の後学習（強化学習や認知行動の注入）が知識タスクにおいて、モデルが生成したハルシネーションを誤って記憶させるメカニズムを分析した。実験により、報酬を受けたハルシネーションの再想起率が平均4.83%向上し、特に難しい問題や誤った事実の記憶が強化されることが示された。また、ハルシネーションへの報酬は、モデルがその誤りを棄却する確率を低下させる（平均7.23%減）ことも確認された。本研究は、推論中心の学習レシピが知識タスクで意図しないハルシネーションの定着を招く経路を体系的に特定した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMのハルシネーション対策と推論・学習手法の関連が直接関心領域

papers.title: How Long Will My Language Model Run? A Benchmark for Pre-Execution Runtime Prediction
papers.summary: Researchers submitting deep learning jobs to shared GPU clusters need runtime estimates to request time limits, choose hardware, and budget compute. Large language models (LLMs) offer a tempting shortcut: describe the job and ask. We introduce PreRun, a benchmark for predicting deep learning training and inference runtime from information available before execution. PreRun contains 801 training and 1,884 inference records of language and vision models collected on a GPU cluster, paired with workload configurations and explicitly defined timing targets. It also includes 64 text-generation configurations measured under standardized conditions, each in three separate program launches. We compare three LLMs (Qwen3.5-9B, GPT-OSS-120B, and Claude Opus 5.5) with regression baselines and evaluate analytical estimates on a supported forward-pass subset. On 16 held-out generation configurations, the open-weight LLMs underestimate latency by 90-99% on average without examples. Claude's zero-shot mean absolute error is 4.5 times that of a Random Forest fit on 32 configurations. Five labeled examples substantially reduce Claude's generation error, but their benefit varies across timing targets. We will open-source our data and evaluation pipeline upon acceptance.
papers.title_ja: 私の言語モデルはどれくらい実行されるのか？実行前の実行時間予測のためのベンチマーク
papers.summary_ja: 共有GPUクラスタでの深層学習ジョブの実行時間を、実行前に予測するためのベンチマーク「PreRun」を提案する。言語・ビジョンモデルの学習・推論記録約2,700件と、標準化されたテキスト生成設定64件を含む。Qwen3.5-9B、GPT-OSS-120B、Claude Opus 5.5などのLLMと回帰ベースラインを比較し、LLMが実行時間を大幅に過小評価する傾向を明らかにした。特に、ラベル付き例を5つ提供することでClaudeの誤差が大幅に減少することが示された。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論の効率化・実行時間予測という実務的課題に直結するベンチマーク研究

papers.title: Your Judge Inherits Your Prompt: In-Context Label Bias in an LLM-as-Judge Is Directional, Not Symmetric
papers.summary: LLM-as-judge has become a standard way to score open-ended model outputs, yet the judge is itself a frozen language model steered by a few in-context examples, and such models are known to absorb the label balance of their demonstrations rather than treat them as neutral illustrations. We ask whether this label bias reaches an LLM judge used inside a multimodal (video question answering) evaluation pipeline, and what form it takes. Using a fully frozen generator-judge pipeline, we hold the generated answers fixed and vary only the Yes/No balance of the judge's few-shot examples across four demonstration sets. Each verdict is validated against a two-annotator human consensus on 200 examples per dataset. The judge's acceptance rate stays close to human consensus when its examples are balanced or skewed toward rejection, but jumps sharply (by about 30 points on NExT-QA and 20 on MSVD-QA, with a strongly one-sided error profile) when the examples are skewed toward acceptance; the opposite skew produces no matching drop. The bias is therefore one-directional within the tested range of label ratios. A separate five-draw analysis shows that results from a single example draw are unreliable, varying by up to 18 points, more than any difference between prompting conditions. We conclude that demonstration label bias in an LLM judge is a directional, inflation-only failure mode that can fabricate apparent benchmark gains but not losses, and that it is cheaply avoided by balancing the judge's examples and reporting results averaged over several draws.
papers.title_ja: あなたのジャッジはあなたのプロンプトを継承する：LLM-as-Judgeにおける文脈内ラベルバイアスは非対称的である
papers.summary_ja: LLM-as-Judge手法において、少サンプルデモのラベルバランスが評価結果に与える影響を分析した。生成モデルを固定し、ジャッジのデモ例のみYes/No比率を変化させた結果、承認偏向のデモでは人間コンセンサスから大きく乖離する一方、拒否偏向では影響が小さい非対称性（方向性）が確認された。さらに、単一のデモ例抽出では最大18ポイントのばらつきが生じるため、信頼性のある評価には複数回の平均化とデモ例のバランス調整が不可欠であることが示された。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM評価・ベンチマークの信頼性向上に直結する実務的知見

papers.title: Budget-Aware Predict-and-Verify Theorem Proving with Heterogeneous LLM Solvers
papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) theorem solvers differ in both proving capability and inference cost. Applying an expensive solver to every subgoal wastes computation when cheaper models are sufficient, while always starting from the cheapest solver wastes attempts on subgoals that require stronger models. We present BudgetPV, an agentic budget-aware predict-and-verify system that allocates computation across unresolved subgoals and heterogeneous LLM solvers. BudgetPV uses a cross-solver predictor to guide solver selection for each subgoal and revises the allocation as verification feedback becomes available. The allocation problem changes as proving progresses. Early decisions mainly determine which solver should handle an untried subgoal, while later decisions determine which previously attempted subgoals should receive additional computation. We train the predictor with two objectives for these two stages. Class-weighted cross-entropy improves assignment to less frequent stronger solvers during the initial stage, while plain cross-entropy provides better calibrated probabilities for later allocation among previously attempted subgoals. We evaluate BudgetPV on Lean Workbook, miniF2F, ProofNet, and PutnamBench using three progressively expanded solver settings: a strong but expensive solver alone, adding a medium-cost solver with intermediate solving capability, and further adding a cheap solver with lower solving capability. BudgetPV requires less LLM generation computation than uniform allocation to solve the same number of subgoals across the evaluated settings. The experiments further show the computation savings obtained as medium- and lower-cost solvers are added.
papers.title_ja: 異種LLMソルバを用いた予算意識型予測・検証定理証明
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、異なる推論コストと能力を持つLLMソルバを効率的に活用するためのエージェントシステム「BudgetPV」を提案する。サブゴールごとに適切なソルバを選択し、検証フィードバックに基づいて計算資源の配分を動的に修正することで、無駄な計算を削減する。予測器は初期段階と後期段階の異なる目的関数で訓練され、Lean WorkbookやminiF2Fなどのベンチマークで、均一配分よりも少ない計算コストで同数のサブゴールを解決できることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論の効率化とエージェント設計、ベンチマーク評価に直結する手法

papers.title: Multi-Tier Edge Triage: Optimizing Latency for Safe Clinical Agents
papers.summary: Deploying generative AI agents in enterprise clinical workflows requires enforcing multi-dimensional safety and compliance policies--preventing HIPAA Protected Health Information (PHI) exposure, maintaining clinical scope-of-practice boundaries, ensuring patient-appropriate reading comprehension, and preserving brand integrity--under interactive latency constraints. Synchronous outbound calls to cloud Large Language Model (LLM) judges add substantial network and decoding overhead onto the critical response path. We present Multi-Tier Edge Triage, a safety screening architecture that co-locates a compact Tier-1 sequence classifier on the clinical agent's host server, resolving clear queries in-process without a network round-trip and escalating only ambiguous queries to a Tier-2 cloud LLM judge. To evaluate Tier-1 encoders without length or unigram shortcuts, we construct four length-matched contrastive twin benchmarks seeded from MedSafetyBench, ASQ-PHI, and a synthetic four-mandate clinical assistant policy (Generic HealthCorp). While frozen local encoders match cloud models on structured PHI detection (>= 98.3% accuracy in <= 23.5 ms), they degrade markedly on semantic safety and symmetric-blocklist prompts. However, end-to-end representation fine-tuning closes the multi-policy accuracy gap: a fine-tuned 335M-parameter BGE-Large classifier achieves 98.90% out-of-fold accuracy versus 99.20% for a zero-shot cloud LLM judge (exact McNemar p = 0.648, zero shared errors), 97.8%-98.2% recall, and a 0.0%-0.4% over-refusal rate in 39.0 ms (>14x faster than cloud LLM evaluation on our benchmark host). Per-policy error analysis reveals ceiling local recall on PHI (100.0%), brand (100.0%), and clinical scope (98.7%-99.3%) violations, isolating residual errors to reading-level checks (93.3%-95.3%) and motivating targeted multi-tier escalation.
papers.title_ja: マルチティアエッジトリアージ：安全な臨床エージェントのためのレイテンシ最適化
papers.summary_ja: 臨床現場の生成AIエージェントにおいて、クラウドLLMへの同期呼び出しによるレイテンシ増大を解消するため、ローカルにコンパクトな分類器（Tier-1）を配置し、曖昧なケースのみクラウドLLM（Tier-2）にエスカレートするマルチティアアーキテクチャを提案する。長さや語彙のショートカットを排除した対照ベンチマークを用いた評価では、凍結済みローカルエンコーダは構造化PHI検出でクラウドモデルと同等の精度（98.3%以上、23.5ms以下）を示すが、意味的セーフティでは劣る。しかし、表現のファインチューニングにより、335MパラメータのBGE-Large分類器がクラウドLLMと統計的に有意差のない98.90%の精度を達成し、クラウド評価比で14倍以上高速（39.0ms）に動作することを示した。ポリシー別エラー分析により、PHIやブランド保護ではほぼ完全な検出が可能である一方、読み取りレベルのチェックに残存エラーがあることが判明し、ターゲットを絞ったマルチティアエスカレーションの必要性を裏付けている。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論高速化・量子化類似の効率化とRAG/エージェント設計の安全評価に直結

papers.title: Improving the Optimisation Landscape for Particle Mixtures
papers.summary: Several methods in statistics and machine learning represent a predictive distribution as an equally weighted mixture of models, or particles, trained via the mixture predictive likelihood. However, we prove that the mixture predictive likelihood is poorly suited to gradient-based optimisation, because it does not identify how the mixture is decomposed across particles, so that a poorly matched particle can be starved of training signal. As a remedy, we study a convex combination between the individual risk, i.e. the average log loss of the individual particles, and the mixture risk. At the particle level, this regularised risk imposes a reverse-KL barrier on the responsibilities of the particles, so that no particle can be starved of training signal. These phenomena are illustrated in two case studies: In the first, a predictively-oriented posterior is computed using mean-field Langevin dynamics, and the numerics are well-behaved only when our regularisation is employed. In the second, ensembles of low-rank adapters are jointly fine-tuned on large language models, across four backbones and eight multiple-choice reasoning benchmarks; direct minimisation of the mixture risk leads to responsibility starvation, whose severity decreases as the competence of the backbone increases, whereas our regularised estimator attains a lower held-out mixture risk on every backbone considered.
papers.title_ja: 粒子混合物の最適化景観の改善
papers.summary_ja: 本研究は、予測分布を粒子（モデル）の等重み混合物として表現する際、混合予測尤度による勾配ベース最適化が粒子間の責任分配を識別できず、一部の粒子が学習シグナルを失う問題（責任飢餓）を指摘する。これを解決するため、個々の粒子のリスクと混合リスクの凸結合を用いた正則化リスクを提案し、粒子の責任に逆KL障壁を課すことで安定した学習を実現する。手法の有効性は、平均場ランジュバン動力学を用いた後方分布の計算と、大規模言語モデル（LLM）の低ランクアダプタアンサンブルのファインチューニングという2つのケーススタディで検証された。特にLLM実験では、バックボーンモデルの能力が高いほど責任飢餓が顕著になる一方、提案手法はすべてのモデルで保持アウト混合リスクを低減し、推論ベンチマークでの性能向上を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMのアンサンブル学習と最適化手法の改善に直結する

papers.title: Run One, Get Two: Near-Free Streaming Safety Checks for Local LLMs
papers.summary: Local LLM assistants decode for one user at a time, so decoding is bound by memory bandwidth and leaves compute idle. Streaming safety checks today trade accuracy against cost. A dedicated guard model is accurate but nearly doubles the latency per token, while a hidden-state probe is cheap but less accurate. We present ToRA, an adapter that runs a second model as an extra row in the generator's decode step, sharing its weights and KV cache. Dual-row kernels read each weight once for both rows. On Qwen3-0.6B, ToRA matches or beats a dedicated streaming guard, with higher F1 on 12 of 17 benchmarks. It detects 11.8 points more unsafe responses than the probe at a similar cost, under 4% added latency per token.
papers.title_ja: 1回実行で2つの成果：ローカルLLMにおけるほぼ無コストのストリーミング安全性チェック
papers.summary_ja: ローカルLLMのデコード時にメモリ帯域幅がボトルネックとなり計算リソースが遊休化している問題に対し、ToRAというアダプタ手法を提案する。この手法は、生成モデルのデコードステップ内で第2のモデルを「追加の行」として実行し、重みとKVキャッシュを共有することで、専用ガードモデルの精度を維持しつつレイテンシ増加を4%未満に抑える。Qwen3-0.6Bでの評価では、17のベンチマーク中12で専用ガードモデルを上回るF1スコアを記録し、隠れ状態プローブよりも11.8ポイント多くの不安全応答を検出できることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論効率化と安全性評価の両立という高関連領域

papers.title: Reward Integrity in Adversarial Reinforcement Learning for LLM Guardrail Red-Teaming
papers.summary: We study reward fidelity in an adversarial reinforcement-learning loop for red-teaming financial-services language-model guardrails. Apparent wins can arise when an attack omits prescribed personally identifiable information (PII), or when a reward judge credits a response that did not break the targeted policy. On attacker-generated and public benchmark examples, TypeSafe Jev checks whether the prescribed PII is present. For outcome scoring, we compare the decision models TypeSafe Jev, Laya (pretrained and post-trained), and pretrained CLM-8B with logged Opus 4.8 judgements from a replay corpus. Post-training markedly improves Laya's agreement with the judge. A separate author-reviewed off-target set establishes that Opus can award false wins. The findings motivate specialised decision-model judges for checking prescribed PII in attack inputs and scoring target responses against the intended policy.
papers.title_ja: LLMガードレールの敵対的レッドチーミングにおける敵対的強化学習の報酬整合性
papers.summary_ja: 金融サービス向けLLMのガードレールを攻撃する敵対的強化学習ループにおける報酬の忠実性を研究する。攻撃が規定された個人識別情報（PII）を省略したり、意図しないポリシー違反に誤って報酬を与えたりする「偽の勝利」問題に対処するため、TypeSafe Jevなどの判定モデルを用いた検証手法を提案する。事前学習済みモデルと比較し、後学習（ポストトレーニング）により判定モデルの精度が向上することを示す。さらに、人間によるレビューを通じて、既存の強力なモデル（Opus）でも誤った報酬を与える可能性があることを実証し、特化型判定モデルの必要性を論じる。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの安全性評価と強化学習の組み合わせであり、評価手法の改善に直結する。

papers.title: Decision Models Are General-Purpose Process Reward Models
papers.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) from verifiable outcomes gives a language agent one reward per episode: every step is credited alike, and nothing about the task is learned when all rollouts fail. The last mile, step-level credit, usually requires step labels, a learned critic, costly LLM judges or hand-written rules. We introduce DM-PRM, which turns a general-purpose decision model -- one answering yes/no questions with probabilities -- into a general-purpose process reward model (PRM), zero-shot: no step labels, no fine-tuning, no critic. DM-PRM asks one question per step and adds the standardised answers to the advantage. It plugs into any policy-gradient method; one model, with one question text per environment, serves household tasks, web shopping and multiple RL methods. With Qwen2.5-1.5B it lifts GRPO by over twenty points on ALFWorld and over ten on WebShop, overtakes GiGPO on ALFWorld and learns in far fewer iterations; it also improves GiGPO and GraphGPO on both benchmarks and reaches the highest success of our comparison, ahead of critic-based PPO and of state-of-the-art GiGPO, HGPO and GraphGPO. Its scores locate useful steps in failed rollouts, and trained agents drop idle actions and explore instead of circling. DM-PRM shows that step credit need not be learned: it can be asked for.
papers.title_ja: 意思決定モデルは汎用プロセス報酬モデルである
papers.summary_ja: 強化学習におけるステップレベルの信用割当（クレジットアサインメント）を、ステップラベルやクリティクスの学習なしに実現する手法DM-PRMを提案する。汎用的な意思決定モデル（Yes/No質問に確率で答えるLLM）をゼロショットでプロセス報酬モデル（PRM）として活用し、各ステップの有用性を評価してアドバンテージに反映させる。ALFWorldやWebShopなどのベンチマークにおいて、既存のPPOやGiGPOなどの手法を上回る成功率と学習効率を示した。失敗したロールアウト内でも有用なステップを特定でき、エージェントの無駄な行動を減らし探索を促進する効果がある。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計と強化学習の効率化に直結する手法

papers.title: Accelerating Muon with Spectral Residual Correction
papers.summary: Muon constructs matrix updates by applying a matrix-sign transformation to momentum. A common route to accelerating Muon is to modify the gradient or momentum before this transformation. We explore a complementary direction: refining the parameter step while retaining Muon's momentum recursion. Derived from the parameter subproblem of the ADMM-Inspired Momentum framework, AIMuon uses the gradient--momentum residual to correct the tentative spectral step. The residual undergoes a separate matrix-sign transformation, while spectral--nuclear duality determines the relative weighting of the momentum and residual directions. In practice, both directions are approximated with Newton--Schulz iterations and their combination is rescaled to match Muon's update magnitude. We establish a stochastic stationarity bound for the corresponding exact iteration. On GPT-2-small, GPT-2-medium, and Qwen3-0.6B, AIMuon reaches Muon's final validation loss with 8.98\%, 10.05\%, and 6.49\% fewer optimization steps, respectively, while achieving lower final validation loss than Muon, Muon-Nesterov, and MONA.
papers.title_ja: スペクトル残差補正によるMuonの高速化
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、行列符号変換を用いた最適化手法Muonの推論効率を高めるための改良手法AIMuonを提案する。勾配と運動量の残差を用いてスペクトルステップを補正し、ニュートン・シュルツ反復で近似することで計算コストを抑える。理論的には確率的定常性の境界を導出し、GPT-2やQwen3などのLLMにおいて、Muonより少ないステップ数で同等以上の検証損失達成を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの最適化高速化と推論効率化に直結する手法

papers.title: How Far Does Lossless Re-tokenization Move an RLVR Update?
papers.summary: Language models assign different probabilities to token sequences that decode to the same string. In reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR), a trainer that re-encodes sampled text may train on a different token sequence with the same reward. We ask how far this moves a training update, and whether the movement has a consistent direction. From one checkpoint, we compare updates on the same rollouts, canonical and with selected tokens split into two pieces, against an update on a different batch. On Qwen2.5-0.5B with three-digit addition, splitting about one token in 25 moves the update 0.556 times as far as replacing the batch. The ratio rises with the fraction split in four models and depends on which tokens are split; within a checkpoint, the displacements share a direction across batches. In a tabular model with one table per tokenization and a single sampled string, we prove that whenever two strings below an unsampled prefix differ in probability, only the zero full-gradient step agrees across tokenizations, however it is weighted. In an audit that decodes and re-encodes resampled rollouts, re-encoding touches up to 5.2% of rollouts but at most 0.08% of tokens, far below the split fractions we test. Training on fixed rollouts, the canonical arm finishes ahead in 14 of 18 pre-registered pairs; the interval for the mean accuracy difference includes zero over all pairs and excludes it only under the registered exclusion rule, which favours the canonical arm.
papers.title_ja: 損失なしリトークナイズはRLVRの更新をどこまで動かすか？
papers.summary_ja: 検証可能な報酬による強化学習（RLVR）において、同じ文字列を異なるトークン列として再エンコード（リトークナイズ）した場合の学習更新への影響を定量的に分析した。Qwen2.5-0.5Bを用いた実験では、約25分の1のトークンを分割するだけで、バッチ全体を差し替える場合の約0.556倍の更新移動が生じることが示された。理論的には、確率が異なるトークン化間ではゼロ勾配ステップのみが一致することが証明され、実務的な監査では再エンコードの影響は限定的だが、正規化されたトークン化が精度面で優位に働く傾向が確認された。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの強化学習とトークナイゼーションの相互作用という、効率化・安定性の観点から高度に関連する。

papers.title: Auditing and Adapting kNNGuard for Long-Context Prompts
papers.summary: Training-free activation guardrails such as kNNGuard score prompts by comparing last-token LLM hidden states (the Layer Ensemble branch, kNNGuard LE) and sentence embeddings (all-MiniLM-L6-v2, Embedding-kNN) against a small reference bank (50 examples per class), combining the two branches into a Fused Ensemble (kNNGuard FE). While effective on short inputs (up to 256 tokens), standard kNNGuard degrades substantially on long inputs (over 1000 tokens): averaged across Qwen3.5-4B and Gemma-4-E4B-it, kNNGuard LE AUROC drops from 0.742 (0.777 and 0.706) to 0.554 (0.587 and 0.521) on Content Harm Moderation (Aegis-2.0), and from 0.994 (0.995 and 0.992) to 0.556 (0.598 and 0.513) on RAG Hallucination Detection (HaluBench). We trace this degradation to three causes: (1) hidden-state drift as sequence length increases, (2) hard 256-token truncation in MiniLM, and (3) signal dilution when a long document is compressed into a single final-token vector. We then evaluate three training-free adaptations: a Length-Routed Dual Bank, a long-context embedding model (Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B), and Strided Window Pooling across intermediate token positions. On Content Harm Moderation, dual-bank routing and strided window pooling raise long-context kNNGuard LE AUROC from 0.554 to 0.828 (+0.274 AUROC) and fused kNNGuard FE AUROC from 0.721 to 0.886 (+0.164 AUROC) with no latency overhead from bank routing. On RAG Hallucination Detection, where the guardrail must verify logical consistency between a generated answer and a retrieved passage, sentence-embedding kNN remains near random chance across all lengths, while length-matched LLM hidden states (kNNGuard LE) recover medium-length detection (AUROC = 0.853) but remain limited on over-1000-token passages (AUROC = 0.607) due to final-token dilution over long contexts.
papers.title_ja: 長文コンテキストプロンプトにおけるkNNGuardの監査と適応
papers.summary_ja: 学習不要なアクティベーションガードレールkNNGuardが、長文コンテキストにおいて性能低下する原因を隠れ状態のドリフトや信号希釈として特定した。長さルーティングやストライドウィンドウプーリングなどの3つの学習不要な適応手法を提案し、コンテンツハームモデレーションのAUROCを大幅に向上させた。RAGハルシネーション検出では、文埋め込みkNNは依然としてランダムレベルに留まる一方、LLM隠れ状態ベースのアプローチは中程度の長さでは有効だが、超長文では最終トークンの希釈により限界があることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: RAGハルシネーション対策とLLM推論効率化に直結する手法

papers.title: LEAN: Library-Based Adaptation for Asynchronous, Federated Fine-Tuning
papers.summary: Federated fine-tuning of foundation models with low-rank adapters (LoRA) is typically reconciled by averaging locally trained adapters. In cross-device settings, where participants hold heterogeneous data and join or leave asynchronously, averaging is poorly suited: locally trained adapters are not identifiable up to permutation, and averages of adapters trained on dissimilar data can be uninformative or unstable. We propose a simple idea called federated library-based adaptation (LEAN), which replaces averaging altogether. The server maintains a library of rank-1 basis pairs; participants check out random subsets, fine-tune them locally as a LoRA adapter, and check them back in, so that each pair is shuffled across sites and trained on many participants' data. Because no aggregation step is required, LEAN operates fully asynchronously and communicates only low-rank parameters. We prove that, in a synchronous setting, LEAN converges to a neighborhood of a stationary point, with the shuffle canceling data heterogeneity at first order. Across image and text fine-tuning benchmarks, LEAN outperforms averaging-based baselines in most settings with substantially less communication, and remains effective under heavy data heterogeneity, where averaging-based methods fail to reach nontrivial accuracy, and under heavy asynchrony, where they degrade substantially.
papers.title_ja: LEAN: 非同期・連合ファインチューニングのためのライブラリベース適応
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、LoRAを用いた連合ファインチューニングにおけるアダプタ平均化の限界を指摘し、非同期環境で有効な手法LEANを提案する。LEANではサーバーがランク1基底ペアのライブラリを維持し、参加者がランダムなサブセットをチェックアウトしてローカルで学習後、チェックインすることで、データヘテロジニティをシャッフルにより相殺する。同期設定下での定常点近傍への収束性を理論的に証明し、画像・テキストのベンチマークにおいて、平均化ベースの手法よりも通信量を抑えつつ、特にデータヘテロジニティや非同期性が強い条件下で優れた性能を示すことを実証した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM効率化・LoRA・実務的評価手法に直結

papers.title: Skill-JEPA: Learning Planner-Aligned Action Spaces for World Models
papers.summary: World models based on Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) learn from pixels to predict the outcome of actions in a latent space. To reach a goal, a planner samples many candidate action sequences, uses the model to predict where each one leads, and executes the best one. However, standard planners draw their candidates from a Gaussian, while the model has only seen the structured, state-dependent actions of its training data. Its predictions for such candidates are unreliable, and planning fails more often as goals move farther away. We propose Skill-JEPA, which learns an action space aligned with the planner. A variational autoencoder conditioned on the current state encodes short action sequences into latent skills with a standard Gaussian prior, and decodes them back into actions. The world model predicts the effect of skills rather than raw actions, and the planner searches over skills starting from that same Gaussian, so its candidates resemble the model's training data. Skill-JEPA adds a single module, trained end-to-end with the world model, and leaves the planner untouched, with no subgoals, hierarchy, or hand-designed skills. Across three JEPA world models and four benchmarks, average success on goals 80 steps away rises from 42% with raw actions to 62%; the gains grow with goal distance and hold across four planners. On AntMaze, a quadruped locomotion task, success on goals two maze cells away rises from 0.4% to 38%. This suggests that part of the difficulty of reaching distant goals lies in the action space, and can be removed without changing the planner.
papers.title_ja: Skill-JEPA: ワールドモデルのためのプランナー整合的アクション空間の学習
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、JEPAベースのワールドモデルにおいて、プランナーがサンプリングするアクション候補とモデルの学習データ分布が乖離し、遠方目標への計画成功率が低下する問題を指摘する。提案手法Skill-JEPAは、状態条件付きVAEを用いてアクションシーケンスを潜在スキル空間にエンコードし、プランナーがガウス分布からサンプリングする候補がモデルの学習分布と整合するようアクション空間を再定義する。これにより、サブゴールや階層構造なしに、80ステップ先の目標達成率が42%から62%へ向上し、AntMazeでは0.4%から38%へ大幅改善した。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習・ワールドモデル・計画アルゴリズムの効率化と一致

papers.title: AI-Assisted Decision Support for Formula 1 Pit-Stop Strategy: Deep Reinforcement Learning and Mathematical Programming
papers.summary: Pit-stop strategy in Formula 1 is a sequential decision problem under uncertainty, in which strategists decide at each lap whether to pit and which tire compound to fit. We develop a data-driven simulator, calibrated with historical race data, that captures tire degradation, drivers' recent performance, overtaking, yellow flag events, and rivals' pit-stop decisions. We train agents with five Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) algorithms and compare them with a Quadratic Mixed-Integer Programming (QMIP) formulation that is optimal in deterministic single-driver settings. Without uncertainty or competition, all DRL methods except TRPO achieve near-optimal performance. With a full grid of competitors and stochastic race events, the ranking of DRL methods depends on the evaluation setting: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) and its recurrent variant are the only methods that improve on the QMIP both in fully simulated races and when the actual 2024 races are replayed. Averaged over eight circuits, PPO improves on the QMIP by 0.33 and 0.49 positions in the two settings and Recurrent PPO by less, and in the replay PPO finishes 0.66 positions ahead of the drivers' actual strategies simulated in the same races. The QMIP performs similarly to the other methods, even though it cannot anticipate yellow flag events. Finally, we use the trained PPO policy as a look-ahead decision-support tool that shows the strategist the distribution of race outcomes under each candidate pit-stop action. Applied retrospectively to eight 2024 races, the look-ahead identifies the laps where the actual decision, the recommendation, or a third action was preferable.
papers.title_ja: F1ピットストップ戦略のためのAI支援意思決定：深層強化学習と数学的プログラミング
papers.summary_ja: F1のピットストップ戦略を不確実性下での逐次決定問題として定式化し、過去データで校正したシミュレータを用いて深層強化学習（DRL）と二次混合整数計画（QMIP）を比較した。競合他車やランダムイベントを含む複雑な環境では、PPOおよびその再帰型バリアントがQMIPを上回る性能を示した。さらに、学習済みPPOポリシーを先見型意思決定支援ツールとして活用し、各候補アクションにおけるレース結果の分布を可視化することで、戦略家の判断を支援する手法を提案した。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習と最適化の比較、意思決定支援ツールという関心に合致

papers.title: Recovering from Averages: An Inverse Problem Perspective on Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials
papers.summary: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) approximate the potential energy surface of atomistic systems from quantum-mechanical reference data and enable molecular simulation at near-ab-initio accuracy at a fraction of the cost. Since they are fitted to total energies and forces, it is not obvious what is estimated: the total energy or the many-body potentials from which it is assembled. Mathematically, this can be formulated as a question whether a function can be recovered from averages of its values over random clusters. We study it for a linear model of fixed correlation order in simplified statistical setting. We show that, in the population limit, the potential is identifiable in a natural weighted Sobolev space, and derive finite-sample recovery guarantees. Numerical experiments for pair, three-body, and four-body models support the theory.
papers.title_ja: 平均からの復元：機械学習原子間ポテンシャルにおける逆問題の視点
papers.summary_ja: 機械学習原子間ポテンシャル（MLIP）が総エネルギーや力から何を推定しているかという理論的曖昧さを、逆問題として定式化し解明する。固定相関次数の線形モデルにおいて、重み付きソボレフ空間内でポテンシャルが識別可能であることを証明し、有限サンプルでの復元保証を導出する。ペア、三体、四体モデルを用いた数値実験により理論的予測を実証し、MLIPの物理的解釈可能性と安定性を数学的に裏付けている。
papers.relevance_reason: MLの理論的基礎だが、軌道力学やLLM効率化とは直接無関係

papers.title: Hierarchical Agentic Mid-Band Agility for Reliable Low-Latency Space-Air-Ground Integrated V2X Networks
papers.summary: Upper-mid-band spectrum offers bandwidth opportunities for the integrated networks of ground vehicles, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), and low Earth orbit (LEO) satellites to support 6G wide-area vehicle-to-everything (V2X) connectivity. However, V2X services' latency and reliability are sensitive to the mid-band selection due to frequency-dependent propagation and rain attenuation. This paper investigates environment-aware spectrum agility over candidate frequency range 3 (FR3) bands within 7.125-24.25 GHz, jointly with end-to-end (E2E) multi-path traffic splitting and transmit power control. Each data packet is partitioned into non-overlapping subflows over direct and UAV-assisted paths, with failed sky-link subflows selectively retransmitted subject to retransmission and freshness constraints. We formulate latency- and reliability-oriented problems, followed by a unified sequential optimization problem incorporating band-switching costs and average quality-of-service (QoS) violation budgets. To coordinate optimization decisions across heterogeneous timescales, we develop an agentic AI-assisted hierarchical multi-agent reinforcement learning (AA-HMARL) framework. A high-level agentic supervisor integrates recurrent memory, analytical evaluation of candidate bands, and event-triggered replanning to coordinate slow environmental adaptation with fast channel and retransmission dynamics, while distributed ground vehicles and UAV agents optimize data splitting and power using constrained MAPPO. Simulation results demonstrate an adjustable reliability-latency trade-off. Particularly, AA-HMARL reduces the mean E2E completion latency and the mean number of retransmission rounds among successfully delivered updates by 17.8-25.5% and 57.6-61.5%, respectively, and reduces the mean age of information (AoI) by 12.7-14.6% relative to fixed-band MAPPO across two traffic types.
papers.title_ja: 信頼性の高い低遅延宇宙・航空・地上統合V2Xネットワークのための階層的エージェント型ミッドバンドアジリティ
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、6G時代の宇宙・航空・地上統合V2Xネットワークにおいて、周波数帯域の動的選択とトラフィック分割を最適化し、低遅延かつ高信頼な通信を実現する手法を提案する。環境認識に基づくスペクトラムアジリティと、エンドツーエンドのマルチパストラフィック分割、送信電力制御を統合した逐次最適化問題を定式化する。これらを解決するため、再帰的メモリとイベント駆動型再計画を持つ上位エージェントと、分散型MAPPOを用いた下位エージェントからなる階層的マルチエージェント強化学習（AA-HMARL）フレームワークを開発した。シミュレーションにより、固定帯域MAPPOと比較して平均完了遅延を17.8〜25.5%、再送ラウンド数を57.6〜61.5%削減できることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習とエージェント設計は関心だが、対象が通信ネットワークであり軌道力学とは無関係

papers.title: SecretAgent: A Multi-Agent Framework for Privacy Protection against Vision Language Models
papers.summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can infer private information from shared images, including locations, personally identifiable information (PII), and personal attributes such as age and sex, even from medical images. Adversarial perturbations can protect such information against black-box VLMs, but existing methods overlook image quality and introduce visible artifacts into the images they protect. We present SecretAgent, the first general multi-agent framework that protects image privacy against VLMs while preserving visual fidelity. LLM agents iteratively locate the visual evidence that reveals private information and adapt an invisible perturbation to the target VLM's answers and to an appearance reviewer agent, which rejects any candidate with visible artifacts. We instantiate SecretAgent with two complementary variants: SecretAgent-Gradient optimizes the perturbation through six surrogate encoders for cross-model transferability, and the gradient-free SecretAgent-Tool composes procedural noise and achieves the best perceptual fidelity on three of the five datasets. Experiments on four privacy applications (geolocation, PII, facial, and medical) across five datasets and six VLMs show that SecretAgent preserves image quality substantially better than existing methods while achieving state-of-the-art privacy protection in every application, and that its protection transfers to other VLMs.
papers.title_ja: SecretAgent: 視覚言語モデルに対するプライバシー保護のためのマルチエージェントフレームワーク
papers.summary_ja: 視覚言語モデル（VLM）が画像から個人情報を推論するリスクに対し、画像の視覚的忠実度を維持しつつプライバシーを保護するマルチエージェントフレームワーク「SecretAgent」を提案する。LLMエージェントが秘密情報を漏洩する視覚的証拠を特定し、外観レビューエージェントが可視アーティファクトを拒否することで、目に見えない敵対的摂動を適応的に生成する。勾配ベースとツールベースの2つのバリアントを実装し、5つのデータセットと6つのVLMで、既存手法より大幅に高い画像品質とSOTA級のプライバシー保護性能、および他モデルへの転移性を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計とVLM評価に関わるが、軌道力学やサロゲートモデルとは無関係

papers.title: Spatiotemporal Graph Neural Networks for Fault Detection and Structural Learning in Chemical Processes: Use Case on the Tennessee Eastman Process
papers.summary: Classical Fault Detection and Diagnosis (FDD) methods, including many data-driven approaches, assume a static normal operating space and interpret deviations from a fixed reference as fault indicators. When Operating Conditions (OCs) vary over time, this assumption breaks down: legitimate transitions trigger false alarms while moderate faults go undetected. We propose a spatiotemporal Graph Neural Network (GNN) framework that decomposes the normal operating space into OC-specific subspaces linked by transition functions, with a dual learning objective combining reconstruction loss and a Deep SVDD one-class term. It learns adjacency matrices through Graph Attention Networks (GATs) and integrates spatial modelling with temporal encoding to represent process dynamics under evolving OCs. This paper evaluates the framework's foundational components (fault detection, GATv2 spatial graph learning and temporal encoding) on the Tennessee Eastman Process (TEP) benchmark, training only on fault-free data. The architecture achieves competitive detection from reconstruction error alone, with similarity-based feature selection improving both accuracy and graph structure diversity. We then evaluate the physical interpretability of the learned attention matrices against 22 ground-truth sensor pairs derived from the TEP control structure and process topology. GATv2 attention fails to recover all known physical pairs across multiple hyperparameter configurations, suggesting a structural limitation of reconstruction-driven attention rather than a tuning issue. This challenges a common assumption in GNN-based FDD: that learned attention weights provide a basis for fault diagnosis and root-cause analysis. The architecture detects faults effectively, but the learned graph does not encode the physical topology needed for interpretable diagnosis, motivating physics-informed graph construction.
papers.title_ja: 化学プロセスにおける故障検出と構造学習のための時空間グラフニューラルネットワーク：テネシーイースタンプロセスへの適用
papers.summary_ja: 運転条件が変化する化学プロセスにおける故障検出（FDD）の課題に対し、時空間グラフニューラルネットワーク（GNN）フレームワークを提案する。この手法は、運転条件固有のサブスペースを遷移関数で連結し、再構成損失とDeep SVDDを組み合わせた二重学習目標により、故障なしデータのみで訓練する。テネシーイースタンプロセス（TEP）ベンチマークでの評価では、再構成誤差のみで競争力のある検出性能を示したが、学習されたアテンション行列は物理的なセンサー対を完全に再現できず、構造学習の限界が示された。この結果は、GNNベースのFDDにおいて学習済みアテンションが根本原因分析の根拠となるという一般的な仮定を揺るがし、物理情報に基づくグラフ構築の必要性を浮き彫りにしている。
papers.relevance_reason: GNNと物理情報モデルの組み合わせに関心があるが、対象が化学プロセスであり軌道力学とは異なるため。

papers.title: An Asymptotic One-Sample Surrogate for Non-Gaussian ERM with General Convex Regularization
papers.summary: We study convex empirical risk minimization (ERM) with non-Gaussian features and nonsmooth penalties through a surrogate driven by a single Gaussian vector. The surrogate preserves the penalty and calibrates its coefficients using the actual joint law of the feature-label model. We prove that this population calibration exists and is unique. We prove a Gaussian approximation for fresh prediction scores when the data satisfy a Poincar\'e inequality. Together with regularity conditions on the losses, this approximation yields agreement between the ERM minimizer and its surrogate in normalized means and prediction variances, as well as formulas for prediction and classification risks. The result covers general uniformly strongly convex penalties and pure Lasso under projection anti-concentration. The core proof relies on a cavity Hamilton-Jacobi argument that compares the main statistics of the two minimizers without differentiating the penalty.
papers.title_ja: 一般の凸則化付き非ガウスERMのための漸近的1サンプルサロゲート
papers.summary_ja: 非ガウス特徴量と非滑らかなペナルティを持つ凸経験的リスク最小化（ERM）において、単一のガウスベクトルによって駆動されるサロゲートモデルを提案する。このサロゲートはペナルティ構造を保持しつつ、特徴量とラベルの実際の結合分布を用いて係数を較正し、その存在と一意性を証明する。ポアンカレ不等式を満たすデータ条件下で、予測スコアのガウス近似を導出し、ERM解とサロゲート解の正規化平均や予測分散の一致、およびリスクの公式を導出する。証明は、ペナルティの微分を必要としないキャビティ・ハミルトン・ヤコビ論法に基づいている。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルの理論的基礎だが、軌道力学やLLM推論への直接適用は薄い

papers.title: Beyond Final Answers: Interpretable Tumor Immune Microenvironment Reasoning from H&E and mIF
papers.summary: Readouts of the tumor immune microenvironment (TIME), such as CD8+ T-cell density, intra-epithelial infiltration and the Ki67 index, combine tissue architecture from H&E with cell phenotypes from multiplex immunofluorescence (mIF). Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) could automate these readouts with an explanation, but two gaps remain. Pathology MLLMs read H&E alone, while these readouts need the cell phenotypes that mIF measures. And their reasoning has no step-level truth to be checked against, so R1-style reinforcement learning rewards only the final answer and leaves the reasoning unverified. Same-section H&E and mIF provide what both gaps lack: mIF measures every cell without manual annotation, which gives cell-level ground truth for each step that clinical guidelines prescribe, from delineating a tissue compartment to counting and normalizing the marker-positive cells within it. We therefore present HERMES (H&E-mIF Reasoning with Multimodal Evidence Supervision), an R1-style MLLM that reasons jointly over paired H&E and mIF in guideline steps and is trained with a process reward that checks every stated quantity against this truth. Across four field-level TIME tasks in colorectal cancer, HERMES (4B) reaches an average accuracy of 84.5%, compared with 74.7% for the strongest of twelve proprietary, general, medical and pathology MLLMs, and a higher share of its intermediate quantities is correct than for the strongest open-weight baseline. Without the process reward, reinforcement learning barely improves on supervised fine-tuning (80.0% vs. 78.8%) and fewer stated quantities are correct; editing a decisive stated quantity changes the answer as implied in all 885 test questions. Without retraining, it keeps the highest average accuracy on an external cohort imaged with CODEX (76.4% vs. 67.3%) and on head and neck cancer, a cancer type absent from training (76.7% vs. 72.5%).
papers.title_ja: 最終回答を超えて：H&EとmIFからの解釈可能な腫瘍免疫微小環境推論
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、病理学的なH&E染色と多重免疫蛍光（mIF）のペア画像を用いて、腫瘍免疫微小環境（TIME）の指標を推論するマルチモーダル大規模言語モデル（MLLM）「HERMES」を提案する。既存のモデルが最終回答のみを強化学習で最適化するのに対し、HERMESは臨床ガイドラインに基づく各ステップの中間量（細胞密度など）をmIFの細胞レベル真値で検証するプロセス報酬を導入している。結腸直腸がんの4タスクで平均84.5%の精度を達成し、12種の既存モデルを上回る。また、プロセス報酬なしでは強化学習の効果が限定的であること、および中間量の正確さが最終回答の信頼性を決定づけることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論とプロセス報酬の手法は関連するが、対象が病理画像であり軌道力学や物理系ではないため中程度。

papers.title: How Language Models Compress and Compare: Understanding Selection with Token Covariance Maps
papers.summary: Many language-model tasks reduce to selecting among structured alternatives, yet we still lack a simple picture of how a decoder-only transformer organizes an entire selection prompt across depth. We introduce token covariance maps, a prompt-level geometric view that tracks how token positions co-vary in hidden-state space at each layer. This turns a structured prompt into a depth-indexed sequence of maps whose spectral and block structure can be aligned with instructions, context, and candidate answers. Across 14 decoder-only models from 4 families and 12 structured-selection benchmarks, token covariance maps reveal a robust compress-then-compare organization. Early layers represent prompts diffusely, middle layers compress them into a shared low-rank bottleneck, and late layers re-expand into context-option and option-option geometry. This organization recurs across larger fixed-template samples, deterministic prompt rewrites, pairwise reranking reformulations, and controlled answer-set manipulations, while also emerging during training from an initially flat depth profile. Its timing aligns with behavior: useful answer discrimination appears well after the bottleneck, and low-rank intervention around the bottleneck preferentially disrupts late comparison geometry. We additionally show that the same geometric profile appears in instruction-tuned models, across several languages, and during open-ended generation. We further show that changing the internal representation of one candidate around the compressed region can shift which candidate the model later prefers. These results show that token covariance maps are a diagnostic tool for comparing how models organize information across prompts, model families, and stages of training.
papers.title_ja: 言語モデルの圧縮と比較：トークン共分散マップによる選択プロセスの理解
papers.summary_ja: デコーダ型Transformerが構造化された選択タスクをどのように処理するかを、隠れ状態空間におけるトークン位置の共分散構造（トークン共分散マップ）で解析する。14モデル・12ベンチマークで検証し、初期層で拡散、中間層で低ランクボトルネックへ圧縮、後期層で候補間の幾何学的比較へ再展開する「圧縮後比較」の普遍的な機構を発見した。この構造は訓練過程や多言語環境でも確認され、ボトルネック付近の介入が最終的な候補選択に影響を与えることを示す。本手法は、モデル内部の情報整理メカニズムを可視化・診断するための強力なツールとなる。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM内部構造の解析であり、推論効率化やエージェント設計への応用可能性が限定的

papers.title: On the loss landscape of the linear neural network: beyond critical points
papers.summary: While the critical points of the loss landscape in linear neural networks have been extensively studied since the seminal work of Baldi \& Hornik in the late 1980s, a description of this landscape at an intermediate or global scale is still lacking. Such a characterization is crucial, particularly as a substantial body of literature indicates that gradient descent circumvents critical points. The present article introduces an intermediate structure, termed the critical thalweg, which encompasses all critical points and exhibits key geometric properties. Beyond providing a geometric proof of Baldi \& Hornik's results using simpler assumptions than the existing literature, this framework offers a global view of the loss landscape that can be easily visualized in a two-dimensional plane. Empirical observations suggest that gradient descent is attracted toward the critical thalweg, along which the loss continues to decrease to its global minimum.
papers.title_ja: 線形ニューラルネットワークの損失景観について：臨界点を超えて
papers.summary_ja: 線形ニューラルネットワークの損失関数の景観における中間スケールの構造を「クリティカル・ソール（critical thalweg）」として定義し、従来の臨界点の議論を超えたグローバルな視点を提示する。この構造はすべての臨界点を含み、Baldi & Hornik の結果をより単純な仮定で幾何学的に証明する。さらに、勾配降下法がこのソールに沿って損失を最小値まで減少させる傾向があることを経験的に示し、最適化のメカニズムを2次元平面で可視化可能にする。
papers.relevance_reason: 深層学習の基礎理論だが、LLM効率化や軌道力学との直接関連は薄い

papers.title: Parasite Features: Causal Abstraction Through Spurious Pathways
papers.summary: Causal Abstraction defines a notion of \emph{equivalence} between a neural network and an algorithm, thus serving as a powerful framework for mechanistic interpretability. In this paper, however, we show the existence of a class of \emph{spurious features} which straightforwardly pass such equivalence tests. Suppose there are two directions in a model's representation space where: (i) one discriminates the input based on some feature, and (ii) the other steers the model towards a certain output. Interpretability methods based on Causal Abstraction (e.g., Distributed Alignment Search) can \emph{spuriously} simulate these directions' combined behavior by leveraging pathways passing through them, giving the impression that the model implements this feature. In such cases, we say the method discovered a \defn{parasite feature}. Experimentally, we show that Distributed Alignment Search finds parasite features using linear alignment maps in two tasks: syntactic agreement and two-digit addition. Our paper highlights an important consideration for Causal Abstraction and contributes to the ongoing debate about best practices for mechanistic interpretability.
papers.title_ja: 寄生特徴：偽経路を通じた因果抽象化
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、機械的解釈性における因果抽象化フレームワークの限界を指摘する。モデルの表現空間内で、入力識別と出力誘導を担う2つの方向性が存在する場合、Distributed Alignment Searchなどの手法がこれらを偽って結合し、「寄生特徴」として誤検出することを示した。文法一致や2桁足し算のタスクにおいて、線形アライメントマップを用いた実験でこの現象を実証している。因果抽象化に基づく解釈手法の信頼性評価や、ベストプラクティス議論への重要な貢献となる。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM解釈性・ハルシネーション対策に関連するが、軌道力学やサロゲートモデルとは無関係

papers.title: Who Should Verify? Reviewer Selection with Partial Information and Outcome Audits
papers.summary: Selecting an AI reviewer requires evidence about what it does after reading a draft. On a fixed batch of items, a team can keep the original answers or adopt one reviewer's answers throughout. We ask how much it costs to certify that the chosen procedure falls at most a specified number of correct answers short of the best available procedure, for every completion of the unobserved evidence.
