When all reviews are available and only verified answer keys cost money, we give an exact stopping rule and an integer program for the cheapest certificate in hindsight. When reviews and keys both have prices, a polynomial-time algorithm using the completed record approximates the minimum certificate cost within a factor logarithmic in the number of procedures. This dependence is tight to leading order unless P equals NP. Finding a certificate can be much more expensive. We exhibit a two-procedure family with $n$ unresolved items where one purchase suffices in hindsight but the exact minimax expected search cost is $(n+1)/2$. For two binary procedures under a known independent and identically distributed item law, five counts suffice to compute an optimal search policy. We replay reviews on 2,000 MMLU questions, 896 numerical reports, and 48 Singapore electricity forecast reports. With reviews available, a targeted audit used 6.9% fewer keys on MMLU and 1.2% fewer on numerical reports than a fixed order selected on development data. Compared with selection by stand-alone accuracy, the chosen procedures gained 2.94 percentage points on held-out MMLU questions and zero on numerical reports. On electricity reports, five checks certified a tie across all 48, yet each procedure was correct only eight times.
papers.title_ja: 誰が検証すべきか？部分情報と結果監査を用いたレビュアー選択
papers.summary_ja: AIレビュアーの選択において、未観測証拠を含む条件下で最善の手続きから許容範囲内であることを証明するコストを最小化する問題を定式化する。全レビューが利用可能な場合の厳密な停止規則と整数計画法、およびレビューとキーにコストがある場合の多項式時間アルゴリズムを提案する。MMLUや数値レポートなどの実データを用いた実験では、固定順序より少ないキー数で監査が可能であり、単独精度による選択と比較して精度向上やコスト削減の効果を実証した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM評価・ベンチマーク手法に関わるが、軌道力学やサロゲートモデルとは無関係

papers.title: Memorization and Generalization in Generative Models: A Perspective From Energy-based Modeling and Associative Memory
papers.summary: Generative models now write working code, produce realistic images, and hold long conversations, yet the mechanisms behind their intelligence still evade our understanding. This thesis explores that puzzle through Associative Memory (AM), in which patterns are stored as energy minima and retrieved through attractor dynamics. Beyond their capacity, AMs form new minima known as spurious states, long regarded as a failure of memory. We argue that this failure is where creativity begins, and that memorization and generalization can coexist as outcomes of one retrieval process. First, we show that diffusion models behave as AMs. With little data, a diffusion model forms a distinct basin of attraction around each training sample. As the data grows, these basins shrink, and spurious states emerge as attractors that blend stored samples yet match none of them. They are the first signs of generative capability. We characterize this transition by measuring the volume, energy, and curvature of these basins across datasets and architectures, including Stable Diffusion. We then turn to language and move beyond the energy-based view of AM. We show that uniform-state discrete diffusion models are AMs capable of retrieving unseen data, with basins of attraction that arise from conditional likelihood maximization alone. As the training set grows, basins around training examples contract while basins around unseen examples expand, until corrupted test sentences are recovered as reliably as training ones. Conditional entropy exposes this coexistence within a single sequence and cheaply diagnoses where a model lies along the transition. Together, these results suggest that AM is a general principle defined by basins of attraction, and that memorization and generalization can coexist within one model. AM thus offers a framework for asking when a generative model recalls and when it creates.
papers.title_ja: 生成モデルにおける記憶と汎化：エネルギーベースモデリングと連想記憶からの視点
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、拡散モデルや離散拡散モデルを連想記憶（AM）として捉え、エネルギー極小値とアトラクターダイナミクスを通じて記憶と汎化の関係を解明する。データ量が増加するにつれ、訓練サンプル周囲の吸引盆地が縮小し、既存サンプルを混合した「偽状態」がアトラクターとして現れることを示し、これが生成能力の初期兆候であると主張する。さらに、条件付き尤度最大化のみから吸引盆地が形成されることを示し、条件エントロピーを用いてモデルが記憶と汎化のどちらに位置するかを低コストで診断する手法を提案する。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの内部メカニズム理解に寄与するが、効率化や軌道力学とは直接無関係

papers.title: Realistic Robustness Evaluation of Tabular Data Driven Models
papers.summary: The increasing adoption of Machine Learning (ML) models in high-stakes applications has raised critical concerns regarding their robustness against adversarial attacks. While extensive research has focused on adversarial example generation in image and text domains, the study of such examples in tabular data remains comparatively limited, despite its widespread use in real-world systems. This work introduces AURORA, a modular, open-source tool for evaluating the robustness of ML models on tabular data classification. It integrates multiple adversarial perturbation methods and evaluation metrics within a unified framework to systematically assess model behavior under adversarial conditions. Central to AURORA is its evaluation report, which focuses on robustness analysis by quantifying performance degradation, comparing the impact of different perturbation strategies, and identifying model vulnerabilities across features and input regions. The report is complemented by visual artifacts that facilitate the interpretability of robustness patterns. Additionally, AURORA incorporates a distance adjustment mechanism that penalizes implausible adversarial samples based on feature-level constraints, ensuring that the robustness assessment remains grounded in realistic perturbations and is therefore more reliable.
papers.title_ja: 表形式データ駆動モデルの現実的な頑健性評価
papers.summary_ja: 表形式データにおける敵対的攻撃への頑健性評価ツール「AURORA」を提案する。複数の敵対的摂動手法と評価指標を統合し、モデルの性能低下や脆弱性を定量的に分析する。特徴量レベルの制約に基づき非現実的な敵対的サンプルをペナルティすることで、現実的な摂動下での信頼性評価を実現する。視覚化成果物を通じて頑健性パターンの解釈性を高める。
papers.relevance_reason: MLモデルの頑健性評価手法であり、実務応用に関心があるが、LLMや軌道力学とは直接無関係。

papers.title: LoCo-WAM: Test-Time Training as Long Context for World-Action Models
papers.summary: World-action models guide robot actions by predicting what happens next, but typically condition on a short observation history. Extending this history increases computation at every decision and can require a separately trained model. We introduce LoCo-WAM, which learns from the outcomes of its actions through test-time training while keeping the same short history length. It uses newly observed frames to update a low-rank adapter in the video expert, whose adapted predictions guide subsequent actions. The updates accumulate within each episode and are reset between episodes, allowing past observations to influence decisions after they leave the input window. LoCo-WAM thus learns from a longer stream of experience without expert action labels, additional data or meta-training. Experiments on two world-action models show improved task success across four simulation benchmarks. On RoboCasa GR-1, a model with 2.4,s of history matches one trained with 9.6,s, while a model with 4.8,s exceeds it by 4.8 percentage points. Our analysis shows that the updates improve prediction of upcoming frames, affect the action mainly through adaptation of the imagined future, and have an increasing effect on actions as the episode unfolds.
papers.title_ja: LoCo-WAM: 世界-行動モデルにおけるテスト時学習による長文脈の活用
papers.summary_ja: ロボットの行動を導く世界-行動モデル（WAM）において、短い観測履歴に依存する制約を解消する手法 LoCo-WAM を提案する。テスト時学習により、新しい観測フレームを用いて低ランクアダプタを更新し、エピソード内で経験の蓄積を実現する。これにより、追加のデータやメタ学習なしで、入力ウィンドウ外のパスト観測が意思決定に影響を与えるようになる。シミュレーションベンチマークでは、短い履歴を持つモデルが長い履歴で訓練されたモデルと同等以上のタスク成功率を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM効率化やRAGとは異なるが、テスト時学習と適応手法は関連する

papers.title: Coherent Moment Propagation: Epistemic Uncertainty for Pre-trained Robot Policies
papers.summary: Flow matching policies underpin the state-of-the-art in robot learning, with impressive results ranging from long-horizon planning to dexterous manipulation. However, they provide no measure of whether their predicted commands can be trusted, particularly in novel situations outside their training set. Epistemic uncertainty reflects uncertainty about the model's weights and quantifies this ignorance, but calculating it at inference time from a flow matching policy is not trivial. Actions are produced by an ODE solver, requiring uncertainty to be propagated through the entire integration process. BayesDiff addresses this problem for diffusion models by propagating the mean and variance of the state through the denoising chain under a last-layer Laplace posterior approximation, but it severely underestimates the epistemic uncertainty. In this paper we: i) prove that, for flow matching and diffusion ODEs, BayesDiff's total variance decays at rate $O(1/T)$ as the number of Euler steps $T$ used by the solver increases; ii) introduce Coherent Moment Propagation (CoMP), two recursions inspired by the extended and unscented Kalman filters that fix this problem by carrying the cross-covariance between state and weights; and iii) widen the last-layer posterior with observation embeddings the policy already computes, improving uncertainty estimates without retraining for CoMP and several test-time estimators alike. We demonstrate these benefits on three manipulation benchmarks with applications in failure detection and demonstration selection for fine-tuning, where CoMP corrects BayesDiff's variance collapse while matching or outperforming several uncertainty estimators.
papers.title_ja: コヒーレントモーメント伝播：事前学習済みロボットポリシーのエピステミック不確実性
papers.summary_ja: フローマッチングベースのロボット学習において、推論時のエピステミック不確実性を正確に推定する手法「CoMP」を提案する。既存手法BayesDiffが不確実性を過小評価する問題に対し、状態と重みの共分散を伝播させることで修正する。拡張カルマンフィルタや無色カルマンフィルタに着想を得た再帰式を用い、再学習なしで不確実性推定を改善する。3つの操作ベンチマークで、失敗検出やデモ選択への応用を通じてその有効性を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 不確実性推定とロボット制御の組み合わせで、ML手法全般に関心があるため中程度

papers.title: Self-Supervised Learning with Recursive Quadrature Filters for Neural Time Series
papers.summary: We develop self-supervised methods for training Recursive Quadrature Filter (RQF) encoders on unlabeled time series. RQFs are biologically motivated, complex-valued temporal filters that form a special class of diagonal state-space models (SSMs). Each RQF acts as a band-pass filter whose selectivity is determined by two learnable parameters: its tuning frequency and bandwidth. We separately introduce a self-supervised learning objective based on prediction error; the encoder is trained so that its current state predicts its own future activity. In the windowed mode, the summary of the current window predicts the summary of a later window; in the dense mode, the state at the current timestep predicts future log-power. Each RQF encoder is pretrained on a dataset and then a readout (e.g., a task-specific classifier) is trained on the output of the RQF encoder, with the encoder either frozen or fully fine-tuned. For multichannel EEG and intracranial recordings, a shared encoder processes each channel separately, and a spatial readout combines the channel representations using electrode locations. Across four neural benchmarks using scalp or intracranial EEG, the pretrained RQF system performs close to the state of the art while using a small fraction of the parameters of the competing models. For example, a 110k-parameter RQF system achieves 0.9247 +/- 0.0022 test AUROC on 100-s TUAB segments, above SAMBA (0.9054) at the same context with 9 times as many parameters, and 0.9040 +/- 0.0019 on 10-s segments, comparable to EEG foundation models with 3.2M-369M parameters.
papers.title_ja: 再帰的四重積分フィルタを用いたニューラル時系列の自己教師あり学習
papers.summary_ja: 生物学的に動機付けられた複素数値時間フィルタである再帰的二次方根フィルタ（RQF）エンコーダの自己教師あり学習手法を提案する。予測誤差ベースの目的関数を用いて、現在の状態が将来の活動を予測するようにエンコーダを事前学習し、タスク固有の読み出し層を訓練する。マルチチャネルEEGや脳内記録データにおいて、共有エンコーダと空間読み出し層により、競合モデルの参数量の極めて一部で最先端に近い性能を達成した。例えば、11万パラメータのRQFシステムは、9倍の参数量を持つSAMBAを上回るAUROCを記録し、大規模なEEG基盤モデルと同等の精度を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 時系列処理の効率化手法だが、軌道力学やLLM推論とは直接無関係

papers.title: CENTRY: A Probabilistic Latent-State Model for Continual AI Risk Estimation, Monitoring, and Regulation
papers.summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems are increasingly deployed in safety-critical applications, yet existing AI safety frameworks primarily define, categorize, or govern AI risk rather than proposing implementable models and methods for continually estimating, monitoring, and regulating risk throughout an AI system's operational lifetime. This paper proposes CENTRY, a probabilistic framework that enables continual risk estimation, monitoring, and regulation of a deployed AI system from its interactions with its environment. The framework models AI risk as arising from three intrinsic sources: datasets, hardware resources, and models/algorithms. A structured latent-variable model is developed in which the latent representation is decomposed into a fast interaction subspace that captures the evolving AI--environment dynamics and three slow latent subspaces that encode the long-term risk states associated with the dataset, hardware, and model components. Rather than requiring a ground-truth risk label at every time step, the component-risk states are treated as latent variables and are learned by maximizing a variational evidence lower bound, optionally informed during training and continual refinement by evidence-supported behavior--cause records. The resulting framework unifies continual probabilistic inference, online risk estimation, and adaptive risk regulation in an implementable architecture. Under the explicit assumptions stated for the corresponding results, we establish formal guarantees spanning safety, learning, inference, and operations, including finite-horizon and asymptotic risk-budget compliance, regret and convergence bounds for adaptive regulation, consistency and identifiability of component-risk ratings, and detection-delay, false-alarm, containment, and computational-complexity characterizations.
papers.title_ja: CENTRY: 継続的AIリスク推定・監視・規制のための確率的潜在状態モデル
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、展開済みAIシステムのリスクを継続的に推定・監視・規制するための確率的枠組み「CENTRY」を提案する。リスクの要因をデータセット、ハードウェア、モデルアルゴリズムの3つの潜在変数として分解し、変分推論を用いて学習する。真のリスクラベルが不要なオンライン推定と適応的規制を統合し、安全性や収束性に関する形式的保証を導出している。
papers.relevance_reason: ベイズ推論・潜在変数モデルという手法は関心領域だが、AI安全規制という応用分野は外れるため。

papers.title: Spectral Estimation with Deformed Decompression
papers.summary: Sample covariance matrices are fundamental objects in machine learning and statistics, with valuable information encoded into their eigenvalues. When treating modern problems, the scale of these matrices can become prohibitive for tractable computation. This creates a critical need for "spectral decompression": a method for inferring the eigenspectrum of a very large-scale model using only information from its smaller realizations. Existing methods fall into two main categories: those relying on spectral inversion; and those that rely on Free Decompression techniques. On the one hand, spectral inversion is a fundamentally ill-posed problem that is notoriously unstable, often failing to yield reliable results in finite-size settings. On the other hand, while Free Decompression was recently proposed to address this scaling, its reliance on the Nica-Speicher framework restricts its use to unitarily invariant ensembles, a symmetry condition that subsampled covariance matrices fail to satisfy. In this work, we introduce Deformed Decompression (DD), a novel framework for the stable, forward-extrapolation of spectral densities. By leveraging properties of the companion matrix, DD recasts the spectral decompression problem as a directed evolution of the Stieltjes transform of the companion matrix. This approach bypasses the instabilities of traditional inversion and provides a robust methodology for scaling covariance matrices and even their generalized variants (including Hessian matrices) that lack unitary invariance. We demonstrate the utility of our framework through experiments on a variety of random matrix examples, showing that DD successfully captures the complex spectral signatures of large-scale systems.
papers.title_ja: 変形デコンプレッションを用いたスペクトル推定
papers.summary_ja: 大規模な共分散行列の固有スペクトルを、より小さい実装情報から推定する「スペクトルデコンプレッション」の手法を提案する。従来のスペクトル逆算は不安定であり、Free Decompressionは対称性の制約があるため、本研究では伴行列の性質を利用したDeformed Decompression (DD) フレームワークを導入する。DDはStieltjes変換の指向性進化として問題を再定式化し、ユニタリ不変性を満たさない行列（ヘッセ行列など）に対しても安定した前方外挿を可能にする。ランダム行列の各種実験により、大規模システムの複雑なスペクトル特性を正確に捕捉できることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 機械学習の数理的基盤となる行列推定手法であり、大規模モデルの解析に有用

papers.title: Fair Property Tax: Reducing Regressivity in Machine-Learning Valuation
papers.summary: Advanced machine-learning models are increasingly used for property valuation in tax assessment. Although these models can achieve high predictive accuracy, they may systematically assign higher valuation-to-sale ratios to lower-priced properties, a pattern known as regressivity. In collaboration with the Cook County Assessor's Office (CCAO), we develop and evaluate two training methods that substantially reduce this regressive pattern while maintaining price-scale predictive accuracy. The Direct method has been incorporated into CCAO's public residential valuation software. Retaining the LightGBM model class used at CCAO, we propose a Direct penalty on squared covariance between log valuation errors and log sale prices, and an observation-additive Surrogate that yields a weighted squared-error loss. We evaluate both methods in our implementation of the CCAO workflow, using seven chronological validation folds, a held-out test set, and a 2025-forward test set. Measured by the magnitude of price-related bias (PRB), regressivity falls by approximately 49% on held-out sales and 39% on 2025 sales at a Surrogate setting selected by cross-validation, relative to the same LightGBM model fitted without the penalty. Price-scale $R^2$ is essentially unchanged. Its small rise, from 0.893 to 0.897 on held-out sales and from 0.904 to 0.908 on 2025 sales, reflects overall valuation level. Log-price RMSE rises by 3.1% and 1.7%, respectively. Paired sale-bootstrap 90% intervals for the PRB reductions lie within about two percentage points of these estimates. In an additional eight-county benchmark, both methods reduce regressivity in every county, with higher log-price prediction error as the expected tradeoff. These findings demonstrate a practical way to reduce measured regressivity within an existing assessor workflow while preserving price-scale predictive performance.
papers.title_ja: 公正な不動産税：機械学習による評価における逆進性の低減
papers.summary_ja: 機械学習モデルを用いた不動産評価において、低価格物件に対して過大評価される逆進性（regressivity）を低減する2つの学習手法を提案する。LightGBMモデルに直接ペナルティを課すDirect法と、加重誤差損失を生成するSurrogate法を実装し、Cook County Assessor's Officeのワークフローで検証した。その結果、予測精度（R^2）をほぼ維持しつつ、価格関連バイアスを約49%低減できることを示した。8郡のベンチマークでも逆進性の低減が確認され、実務的な公平性向上手法として有効であることが示された。
papers.relevance_reason: ML手法と評価指標の活用は関連するが、宇宙・軌道力学の文脈ではないため中程度

papers.title: Cross-Attack Robust Aggregation for Federated Learning
papers.summary: Federated learning (FL) lets resource-constrained IoT and edge devices train a shared model without exchanging raw data, but compromised or faulty devices can poison the global model. Existing robust aggregators each fail in some regime: naive averaging (FedAvg) collapses under high-magnitude attacks, whereas distance- and statistics-based defenses (Krum, median, trimmed mean) sacrifice accuracy on non-IID data and remain vulnerable to stealthy attacks. We present FedTether, which reweights client updates by their deviation from a coordinatewise median through a robust, dead-zoned score applied as a server-side optimizer step. Across three datasets, three attack types, and Byzantine fractions up to 40%, FedTether is the only method top-tier in every regime: it matches FedAvg under stealthy attacks with no robustness tax, exceeds robust baselines by up to 42 accuracy points, and stays accurate where high-magnitude attacks reduce FedAvg to near-random. These properties persist at 50 clients under partial participation, with no shared data or validation set.
papers.title_ja: 連合学習におけるクロスアタック耐性アグリゲーション
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、連合学習（FL）におけるバイザンチン攻撃や故障デバイスによるモデル汚染問題に対処する新しいアグリゲーション手法「FedTether」を提案する。既存手法が非IIDデータでの精度低下や巧妙な攻撃への脆弱性を抱える中、FedTetherは座標ごとの中央値からの偏差に基づきクライアント更新を重み付けする。3つのデータセットと3種類の攻撃条件下で、FedTetherは他の手法が劣化する領域でも高精度を維持し、特に高振幅攻撃下でFedAvgがランダムレベルに落ち込む際にさえ正確性を保つことを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 機械学習手法全般に関わるが、ユーザーの関心であるLLM効率化や軌道力学とは直接関連が薄い。

papers.title: Graph-XGB: A Hybrid GNN Framework for Outdoor-to-Indoor 5G Signal Reconstruction via Aerial-Only UAV RF Sensing
papers.summary: Delivering robust In-Building Coverage (IBC) is critically impeded by severe Outdoor-to-Indoor (O2I) attenuation, a constraint that intensifies as deployments move from 5G mid-band towards mmWave and prospective 6G sub-THz carriers, where losses of 60-80 dB have been reported across modern building envelopes. While Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) offer scalable exterior RF sensing platforms, a fundamental inversion problem persists: interior 3D signal states cannot be directly sampled from constrained exterior flight paths. This paper proposes Graph-XGB, a hybrid inference framework that decouples spatial topology reasoning from non-linear signal regression to resolve this challenge. A modified SpiderGNN encoder, operating on a topology-aware graph constructed with a physically grounded Floor-Aware 3D Distance metric and Bridge Edge Guarantees, propagates UAV boundary measurements into 128-dimensional indoor embeddings. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) compresses these into a 10-dimensional manifold retaining 96.6% of embedding variance, fused with raw spatial features and decoded by independent, physics-tailored XGBoost regressors. This decoupling mitigates the optimization conflict between smoothly decaying path-loss signals and volatile interference-dependent metrics. Evaluated on a real-world 5G NR dataset of 613 verified nodes spanning the 10 floors of a single building, Graph-XGB attains the strongest accuracy among the architectures compared, with $R^2$ of 0.759 (RSSI) and 0.770 (RSRP), improvements of 35.5% and 64.9% over the SimpleGNN baseline, using no interior RF measurement as a model input; indoor observations enter only as training supervision, with evaluation on held-out internal nodes. Interference-dependent targets (RSRQ, SNR and CQI) remain bounded well below the path-loss metrics, delimiting the reach of purely spatial inference.
papers.title_ja: Graph-XGB: 屋外から屋内への5G信号再構築のための、空飛ぶUAVによるRFセンシングを用いたハイブリッドGNNフレームワーク
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、UAVによる屋外RFセンシングのみを用いて屋内の5G信号状態を推定するハイブリッド推論フレームワーク「Graph-XGB」を提案する。物理的に根拠のある3D距離メトリクスを用いたグラフ構造上でSpiderGNNエンコーダが空間トポロジーを処理し、PCAによる次元削減後にXGBoostリグレサで非線形信号回帰を行うことで、パスロスと干渉指標の最適化競合を緩和する。実測データセットでの評価により、屋内RF測定をモデル入力に使用しないにもかかわらず、ベースライン比で最大64.9%の精度向上（R^2 0.770）を達成した。ただし、干渉依存指標（RSRQ, SNR等）は純粋な空間推論の限界により精度が低く留まる。
papers.relevance_reason: GNNとXGBoostのハイブリッド手法はML全般に関心だが、5G信号推定という特定領域であり軌道力学やLLM効率化とは直接無関係。

papers.title: A Sparsity Analysis of Traffic Forecasting Architectures: How Much Missing Data is Too Much?
papers.summary: Traffic forecasting models are typically evaluated under ideal conditions with complete data. This evaluation does not reflect the frequent sensor failures and communication outages common in real-world deployments. This paper presents a comprehensive analysis of multivariate traffic prediction models to evaluate their performance under varying levels of sensor data loss during inference. We benchmark several architectural paradigms, including graph neural networks, attention-based Transformers, and selective state-space models, across sparsity levels ranging from zero to complete sensor loss, using two widely used multi-channel traffic benchmarks. To ensure consistent comparison across traffic variables, we use normalized metrics and define a usability threshold to identify when predictions become unreliable. Our results show a clear trade-off between baseline accuracy and robustness: models with the highest accuracy under full-data conditions often degrade most sharply as data becomes sparse, while less accurate models maintain more stable performance. These findings show that model selection should be based on the expected reliability of the sensor network rather than peak accuracy alone. This work provides a practical framework for assessing traffic forecasting models and highlights the importance of robustness in real-world applications.
papers.title_ja: 交通予測アーキテクチャのスパース性分析：欠損データがどの程度で許容限界を超えるか？
papers.summary_ja: センサー故障や通信途絶が頻発する実環境を想定し、交通予測モデルのデータ欠損耐性を評価した。グラフニューラルネットワーク、Transformer、状態空間モデルなどの主要アーキテクチャを、完全欠損までのスパースレベルでベンチマークした。結果、完全データ時の精度が高いモデルほど欠損時に性能が急落し、精度が低いモデルの方が安定性を保つ傾向が確認された。センサー網の信頼性を考慮したモデル選定が重要であり、実務的な評価フレームワークを提案している。
papers.relevance_reason: 交通予測は対象外だが、モデルの頑健性評価手法は参考になる

papers.title: Online Learning for Minimizing Maximum Tardiness in Single-Machine Scheduling
papers.summary: We study online learning for minimizing maximum tardiness (\OMMT) in single-machine scheduling. In each round, the learner selects a permutation of \(n\) fixed jobs, representing a schedule. The environment then reveals a processing time and a due date for each job, and the learner incurs a vector-valued loss whose components correspond to the tardiness of the individual jobs. The goal of the learner is to minimize \(\alpha\)-regret, the difference between the learner's maximum cumulative tardiness and \(\alpha\) times that of the best fixed permutation in hindsight, for as small \(\alpha\) as possible. We investigate OMMT under both stochastic and adversarial environments. In the stochastic setting, we prove that the expected \(1\)-regret of the Follow-the-Leader (FTL) algorithm is \( O\!\left(\frac{n\log n}{\Delta^2}\right) \), together with a corresponding high-probability bound, where \(\Delta\) is a distribution-dependent gap parameter. At round \(t \in \{1,\dots,T\}\), FTL runs in \(O(tn^2)\) time and \(O(tn)\) space. In the adversarial setting, we prove that, for any \(0<c<\log_2 n/16\), the \(\alpha\)-regret is \(\Omega(T)\) whenever \(\alpha<\log_2 n/16-c\). We then reduce OMMT to a surrogate online learning problem and apply Follow-the-Perturbed-Leader (FTPL), obtaining an expected \(\alpha\)-regret bound of \(O(n^2\sqrt{T})\) for \(\alpha=O(\log n)\). Thus, the logarithmic dependence of \(\alpha\) on \(n\) is tight up to constant factors. Each FTPL update admits a mixed-integer programming formulation whose size is polynomial in \(n\) and \(t\).
papers.title_ja: 単一機械スケジューリングにおける最大遅延最小化のためのオンライン学習
papers.summary_ja: 単一機械スケジューリングにおける最大遅延（Maximum Tardiness）を最小化するオンライン学習問題を研究する。確率的環境ではFollow-the-Leaderアルゴリズムの期待1-regretがO(n log n / Δ^2)であることを証明し、敵対的環境ではFollow-the-Perturbed-Leaderを用いてα=O(log n)に対してO(n^2√T)のα-regret境界を導出した。各アルゴリズムの計算複雑性を分析し、敵対的設定における理論的下界も示している。
papers.relevance_reason: オンライン学習と最適化手法だが、LLMや軌道力学との直接的な関連性が低い

papers.title: Large Reported CHB-MIT Adaptation Gains Disappear with Pretrained Encoders and Matched Probes
papers.summary: Dani and Liebe (2026) (DL) report that adapting the final encoder block of BIOT and CBraMod with self-supervised learning (SSL) improves CHB-MIT seizure-detection ROC-AUC by 36.2 and 29.5 points over linear probing. We investigate these results with their released code and an independent pipeline. The release loads pretrained weights for adaptation only when an otherwise unset configuration key is supplied, and its CBraMod probe reads the reconstruction head with dropout active. With pretrained initialisation and a probe on the encoder output in evaluation mode, the fixed-recipe adaptation gain on DL's split is -0.6 points for BIOT (95% interval [-3.8, +2.6]) and +0.01 for CBraMod ([-0.02, +0.04]) across five seeds. Across DL's split and five subject rotations on CHB-MIT and Siena Scalp EEG, with equally tuned linear probes (30 configurations, up to 500 epochs, validation-based early stopping), mean adaptation effects range from -1.1 to +5.7 ROC-AUC points over 18 comparisons (related settings and feature variants). Twelve of 18 support equivalence within +/-3 points under dependence-adjusted inference (8 of 12 rotation and 4 of 6 fixed-split comparisons); six are unresolved. After correcting rotation intervals for dependence, no positive effect has a 95% interval excluding zero. The +/-3 margin is an analysis threshold, not a clinically validated one, and smaller margins support fewer equivalences. Two fixed-probe gains near +21 points shrink under the same tuning, with smaller benefits unresolved. We also audit a CHB-MIT protocol shared by at least 14 papers. No tested configuration reproduces DL Table 1 as a whole. These findings concern the tested configurations; the encoder-level probe and subsequent checks were chosen post hoc.
papers.title_ja: 事前学習エンコーダと同等のプローブを用いると、報告されたCHB-MIT適応効果は消失する
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、自己教師あり学習によるCHB-MIT発作検出性能向上の報告を再検証し、事前学習重みの適切な初期化と評価モードでのプローブ使用により、従来の大幅な性能向上がほぼ消失することを示した。厳密なチューニングと統計的検定を経て、適応手法と線形プローブの間に有意な差がないことを確認した。さらに、既存研究で共有されるプロトコルの再現性問題も指摘している。
papers.relevance_reason: 医療画像・生体信号の検証であり、LLMや軌道力学の関心とは遠い

papers.title: Affine-Image Propagation for Tight and Scalable Neural Network Verification
papers.summary: While bound propagation methods are highly effective for certifying neural networks against $\ell_{\infty}$ adversaries, tight and scalable verification for $\ell_{2}$ adversaries remains a significant open challenge. Existing methods incur geometric loss by enclosing preactivation sets in elementwise intervals or axis-aligned ellipsoids, and functional loss by restricting the linear bounds constructed over those domains. Consequently, tight $\ell_{2}$ verification is currently restricted to Lipschitz-regularized networks where these approximations are accurate. In this paper, we introduce affine-image SDP-CROWN, a novel bound propagation method that better approximates preactivation domains using affine-image constraints and jointly optimizes the linear bound to adapt to the resulting domain. To bypass the prohibitive computational cost of dense semidefinite constraints required by the affine-image representation, we replace them with scaled diagonal-dominance conditions, allowing a GPU-accelerated implementation. Our method preserves the bound propagation recursion and can be integrated with branch-and-bound. On five MNIST and CIFAR-10 non-Lipschitz-regularized networks, our method improves verified accuracy over state-of-the-art methods by 17% to 57.5%. With branch-and-bound, these improvements increase to between 27% and 63.5%.

papers.title: The Time Domain Telescope: A Global Spectroscopic Array
papers.summary: The Time Domain Telescope (TDT) is an initiative in the context of the ESO Expanding Horizons program. The TDT project aims for a global telescope array for spectroscopic time-resolved and time-critical observations in the optical-near-infrared, with a core at the European Southern Observatory and partners around the world. The TDT core consists of 100 unit telescopes of 2-meter diameter each that are fully Adaptive Optics-assisted in the blue, to deliver an enclosed energy of >=80% within 0.12" at 400nm. The unit telescopes are coupled to a set of spectrographs covering spectral resolutions R=10^3 - 10^5 over the wavelength range 0.35 - 1.8 micrometer. The combination of extreme adaptive optics with near-read-noise-free detectors will allow the TDT to reach unprecedented depths and/or high cadence. When all 100 units target a single object a depth of 25 mag can be reached in 30 minutes at a signal-to-noise ratio of 10 per spectral resolution element at a spectral resolution of R=5000. With this the TDT will spectroscopically match the imaging depth of the Vera Rubin Observatory and the Euclid and Roman spacecrafts, the expected brightness of electromagnetic counterparts discovered by the LISA space mission, as well as by the next-generation gravitational wave detectors. The science of the TDT covers a large part of astronomy, and ranges from the outer Solar System, to stellar and binary systems to extragalactic transients and the growth of supermassive black holes, all the way back to the expansion history of the Universe. The TDT is transformational, unique and highly complementary to the current and near-future ESO facilities, in particular by providing the possibility for time-resolved spectroscopic observations well below the brightness of the optical night sky.

papers.title: Coronagraphic time-delay interferometry: fundamental steps towards concrete applications
papers.summary: The Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA) is a future space-based gravitational wave (GW) observatory. Central to LISA data analysis is time-delay interferometry (TDI), which reduces otherwise overwhelming laser frequency noise. In previous work, we explored coronagraphic TDI, a sky-dependent null-stream channel which cancels the GW signal of a point-like source when pointed at its sky position. Because this property relies only on the geometric response of LISA, coronagraphic TDI is a candidate for model-agnostic sky localization. Here, we address three challenges which arise when analyzing realistic LISA data: (i) spacecraft motion; (ii) signal superposition; (iii) instrumental noise. We derive a second-generation coronagraphic TDI variable and its analytic noise model, and show that it reduces laser frequency noise in the presence of spacecraft motion while still recovering the position of the source. Using pairs of Galactic binaries (GBs), we find that sources can be localized independently provided they do not overlap in frequency, even when they share the same sky position, whereas sources overlapping in frequency can only be localized if one dominates by a factor of ~100 in amplitude. This is confirmed by the analysis of a simulation containing a massive black hole binary and 49 verification GBs. Finally, we introduce a statistical test based on the analytic noise model, which provides well-calibrated confidence regions for the sky position of the source. Applying it to GBs in the presence of instrumental noise, we find that the geometric response alone only weakly constrains the sky position: even at signal-to-noise ratios of order 10^4, 90% confidence regions span ~10^3 deg^2. These are fundamental steps towards applications of coronagraphic TDI to LISA data, such as sky localization and glitch discrimination, which we discuss.

papers.title: Stellar activity demotes GJ 9404 b to a planetary candidate
papers.summary: GJ 9404 is a nearby M dwarf ($d=23.8\,\text{pc}$), around which a $13.4586^{+0.0044}_{-0.0067}\,\text{d}$ planet has been claimed in a recent study using 54 publicly available HARPS-N radial velocities (RVs). We re-analyse the spectroscopy associated with this study, and carry out a joint modelling of: (i) stellar rotation in RV, FWHM, and Mount Wilson S-index through Gaussian processes; (ii) long-term trends in all physical quantities; (iii) planetary signals in RV. Current evidence supports the existence of planets in the period range $2-100\,\text{d}$ by at most $\Delta\ln Z=-0.4$ for any considered stellar-activity model, which is insufficient for a widely accepted planet detection. Additional spectroscopy is necessary to accurately quantify the stellar activity of GJ 9404 and determine whether any RV signals warrant further attention.

papers.title: NitroGen: Observations on the Action Dynamics, Visual Instruction Following, and Spatial Exploration
papers.summary: NitroGen is an open vision-action foundation model for game control. It is trained by behavior cloning on online gameplay videos. In this paper, we study the frozen controller in Hollow Knight and Trackmania as examples along three dimensions: action adaptation, visual instruction following, and spatial exploration.
